kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.0: %1$sFestival! Seen the lion dance in the square? The tail end fell over, hahaha!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.0.kasar: %1$sSo crowded. The pickpockets are feasting too. Mind your purse.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.0.kuno: %1$sRed lanterns, drums, children's laughter. Days like this nourish the heart.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.0.kampun: %1$sVillage feast, child! A puppet show all night. Bring a mat!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.0.pelabu: %1$sEvery boat is decked out, mate! Rowing race tonight!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.1: %1$sTry the candied haws at the end stall. Thick sugar, fresh fruit.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.1.oasis: %1$sHoney dates and free camel milk at the festival, friend! Drink your fill!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.1.air: %1$sThey're floating the lotus lanterns, dear... come, make a wish...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.2: %1$sThe kids have waited for the fireworks since afternoon. So have I, really. Heh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.2.p: %1$sNew dress today. Nice, isn't it? Sewed it myself over three nights.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.3: %1$sThere's an opera stage by the temple. A play about a loyal general. I cry every year.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.festival.4: %1$sOnce a year this town forgets its troubles. Enjoy it, %2$s!%3$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.0: %1$sThere's a wedding today! Hear the suona? The bride is on her way.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.0.kuno: %1$sTwo families become one today. Heaven smiles.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.0.kampung: %1$sA wedding, child! Come eat, everyone's invited.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.1: %1$sThe red sedan is so pretty. The bride must be nervous.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.1.p: %1$sI sat in a red sedan like that once. Trembled all the way. Hehe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.1.pelabuhan: %1$sThey're marrying on the dock, mate. Every ship rings its bell.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.2: %1$sDon't forget a red envelope if you go in. It's the thought that counts.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.nikah.3: %1$sMay they be happy until their hair turns white. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.0: There's a funeral today. Keep your voice low.
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.0.kasar: A funeral. Don't laugh around here.
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.0.kuno: A soul returns to heaven today. Let us honour it.
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.0.kampung: There's a death, child. The whole village walks to the grave.
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.1: Spirit money flutters down the road. The family wants the departed to lack nothing there.
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.1.pelabuhan: They're scattering the ashes at sea, mate. Every boat is still.
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.2: I knew them. A good soul. The world grows lonelier. %1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.makam.3: If you pass a funeral procession, step aside and bow your head. That's the custom here.
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.0: %1$sA baby was born in this lane! Red eggs are going round; take one!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.0.kasar: %1$sNew baby. Tonight's going to be loud.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.0.kuno: %1$sA new life has come among us. May it grow with strong roots.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.0.kampung: %1$sSomeone gave birth, child! A boy, so chubby!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.1: %1$sThe grandmother picked a name from an old book. A lucky name, she says.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.1.p: %1$sI helped with the birth last night. Tired, but happy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.lahir.2: %1$sBabies born in %2$s, the elders say, take a %2$s temper. Heh, who knows.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.0: Get inside! The beasts are outside the walls!
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.0.kuno: Foes at the gate! Those with strength, help defend the town!
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.0.kampun: The drums are pounding! Come, children, to the village hall! Quick!
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.1: %1$s, you're a cultivator, aren't you? Please, the guards can't hold alone!
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.1.pelabu: Pirates! Every boat into the bay, mate!
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.1.iblis: An attack. Good. Time to see who's truly strong in this city.
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.2: My child is still out there! Has anyone seen my child?
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.2.p: My child! My child is still at the well! Help!
kultivator.cakap.acara.serangan.3: May the town's ward formation hold. %1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.0: Fire! Grab a bucket, quick! To the well, to the well!
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.0.kasar: Don't just stand there! Bring water!
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.0.kuno: Fire devours the houses! %1$s, if you have a water art, now is the time!
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.0.kampu: Fire! Come, everyone bring buckets! Help, help!
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.1: The baker's house is burning. The smoke reaches the market. %1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.1.air: Lucky there's the canal! Everyone's drawing water from it, dear!
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.2: I hope no one's trapped inside.
kultivator.cakap.acara.kebakaran.3: A lantern fell last night, they say. One lantern, one lane burned.
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.0: %1$sThe pickpocket's caught! Look, tied to the market post!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.0.kasar: %1$sServes them right! Let their hands learn.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.0.kuno: %1$sA small justice in the market today. May the thief repent.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.1: %1$sMy purse came back! For three days I thought it was gone forever. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.1.p: %1$sMy earrings are back! A gift from my mother! Oh, thank heaven!
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.2: %1$sThe thief turned out to be a youngster. A bit sad, but still wrong.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.copet.3: The market will be calm a few days. Until the next thief comes.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.0: Shh... the Ghost Market opens tonight. Don't turn if someone calls your name.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.0.kas: Ghost Market. Fools go, fools vanish.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.0.kun: Tonight the boundary of worlds thins. The spirits' market opens.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.1: %1$sWhite lanterns hang on the old road. If you pass, don't step on your own shadow.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.1.air: %1$sBoats without rowers on the canal, dear... I won't go out...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.2: %1$sMy grandfather said: at the Ghost Market, never haggle. Pay what's asked, then leave.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pasar_hantu.3: %1$sSomeone bought a long life there, they say. Paid for it in memories.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.rombongan.0: %1$sA train's arrived! Look at the horses, huge!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.rombongan.0.kuno: %1$sA train from far lands stops in our town. News of the wider world.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.rombongan.0.oasis: %1$sA great caravan, friend! Over a hundred camels!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.rombongan.1: %1$sThey brought spices I've never smelt. The market smells like a god's kitchen.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.rombongan.1.pelab: %1$sA trading fleet has docked, mate! The pier's full to the end!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.rombongan.2: %1$sThe train master seeks a guide to the %2$s. Good pay.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.0: %1$sRice is up again. They say the caravan from the south is held by bandits. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.0.ka: %1$sMad prices. What are the poor to eat? Grass?
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.0.ku: %1$sWhen the granaries empty, the people's hearts empty too.
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.0.ka: %1$sRice is dear, child. Cassava for now. It's fine, healthy.
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.1: %1$sThe queue at the town granary has been long since dawn.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.1.ib: %1$sThe palace opened the emergency granary. May it last till harvest.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.harga_pangan.2: %1$sIf this goes on, people will steal. An empty belly knows no law.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.bangun.0: %1$sThe builders have worked since dawn. The hammering never stops.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.bangun.0.kuno: %1$sThis town rebuilds itself. Like bamboo growing after fire.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.bangun.0.kampung: %1$sWorking together, child! Come help lift bamboo!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.bangun.1: %1$sA new roof goes up today. The owner's preparing roast pork for the builders.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.bangun.1.ibukota: %1$sThe works officer watches every beam. The capital may not lean.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.bangun.2: %1$sThe house that was damaged is now better than before.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pelindung.0: %1$sA new sect banner went up at the gate today. Our town has a protector!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pelindung.0.kasar: %1$sNew protector. Hope they're more use than the last.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pelindung.0.kuno: %3$s now shelters this town. May their Dao be long.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pelindung.1: %1$s's disciples marched through the market. Very dashing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pelindung.1.kampu: %3$sThe village kids marched behind %1$s's disciples. So sweet.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.pelindung.2: %1$sThe town head is holding a banquet for the sect envoys. You can smell it from here.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.0: Happy new year, %1$s! May your fortune overflow this year!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.0.kuno: The new year sweeps away the old year's dust. May your Dao advance, %1$s.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.0.kamp: Happy new year, child! Got your red envelope yet?
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.1: %1$sI've pasted the red couplets on my door. This year must be better.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.1.p: %1$sI made dumplings all night till my fingers wrinkled. New year means dumplings!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.1.pela: %1$sNew year, mate! Every ship home, every sailor drunk!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.2: %1$sFirecrackers scare off demons. And my dog. Poor thing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.tahun_baru.3: %1$sThe year %2$s is here. How fast time runs.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.0: %1$sHarvest home! Full granaries, full bellies, glad hearts!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.0.kasar: %1$sHarvest. Finally I can pay my debts.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.0.kuno: %1$sThe earth has given. Let us thank heaven and the ancestors.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.0.kampung: %1$sHarvest, child! Harvest dance on the field tonight. Don't miss it!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.1: %1$sEvery grain is plump this year. A year's toil repaid.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.1.gunung: %1$sThe monks receive the first harvest offering. The blessing is shared by all.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.panen.2: %1$sRice will surely drop after the harvest. At last!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.0: It's Qingming today. I'm going to sweep my parents' grave.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.0.kasar: Qingming. The graves are packed. Roads jammed.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.0.kuno: Today we remember the ancestors. A tree must never forget its roots.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.0.kampun: Visiting the graves, child. Bring flowers and water for grandpa's grave.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.1: I brought my father's favourite cakes. May he taste them there.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.1.p: I brought my mother's favourite face powder. She always wanted to look lovely.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.2: A drizzle on Qingming. As if heaven weeps too.
kultivator.cakap.acara.qingming.3: A willow sprig at the door wards off evil spirits. Put yours up?
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.0: %1$sSuch a clear sky today. A good omen, they say.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.0.kuno: %1$sA cloudless clear sky. A good omen for anyone's road.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.1: %1$sWeather like this is good for drying anything. Mattresses, fish, even yourself. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.2: %1$sThe sun is friendly today. May it last till harvest.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.2.kamp: %1$sThe sun's kind, child. Hope it holds till harvest.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.3: %1$sOn clear days like this, plenty of outside traders come.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.3.pela: %1$sClear like this the merchantmen come in, mate. The dock will be packed.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.4: %1$sA clear day like this brightens my heart too. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.4.kasa: %1$sClear. Good. Don't waste time on the weather.
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.5: %1$sLook, the swallows fly high. It won't rain.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.cerah.5.oasi: %1$sLook, friend, the hawks fly high. No sandstorm today.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.0: %1$sRaining since dawn. The streets have turned to porridge. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.0.kamp: %1$sRaining since dawn, child. Every bund is slippery.
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.1: %1$sFarmers rejoice, washerfolk weep. That's rain for you.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.1.kuno: %1$sThe same rain gladdens the farmer and grieves the washer. So is heaven.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.2: %1$sMy roof leaks again. Three buckets on the floor already.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.2.pela: %1$sMy warehouse roof leaks again, mate. The salt sacks turned to brine.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.3: %1$sRain like this calls for hot noodles at the eatery. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.4: %1$sThe old folk say rain on market day means fortune arrives late.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.4.air: %1$sRain on the canal is music, isn't it. The boats rock in rhythm.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.5: %1$sThe smell of wet earth reminds me of childhood.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.hujan.5.kuno: %1$sThe scent of wet earth awakens childhood memories, %3$s.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.0: %1$sThat bolt struck near the tower. My ears are still ringing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.0.kasa: %1$sThat bolt nearly hit the tower. Impressive.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.1: %1$sIn storms like this no ship dares sail. Fish prices will rise.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.1.pela: %1$sStorms like this, mate, boats get double-tied. Tomorrow fish prices leap.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.2: %1$sMy children are hiding under the table. I'm pretending to be brave.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.2.p: %1$sMy children hide under the table. I pretend to be calm while hugging them.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.3: %1$sThe almanac says storms this season mean a dragon is shedding scales.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.badai.3.kuno: %1$sThe old books say this season's storms are a dragon shedding its scales.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.0: %1$sFirewood costs as much as meat now. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.1: %1$sThe children built a snowman in the square. Its nose is a carrot stolen from my kitchen.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.1.kasa: %1$sKids made a snowman. With my carrot. Brats.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.2: %1$sThe first snow is always pretty. The tenth is only a nuisance.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.2.kuno: %1$sThe first snow is poetry; the tenth is only work.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.3: %1$sThe well froze this morning. We had to break the ice with an axe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.salju.3.gunu: %1$sThe monastery pond froze. The young monks break the ice while singing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.0: %1$sIn Qi mist like this, every cultivator on the hill must be meditating.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.0.kuno: %1$sThe Qi mist descends; the Dao walkers on the hill must be absorbing it.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.1: %1$sHerbs grow so fast when the Qi mist falls. The herb farmers are glad.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.1.gunu: %1$sCliff herbs grow twice as fast in Qi mist. The herb pickers are so busy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.2: %1$sMy grandmother said Qi mist makes ordinary folk dream of past lives.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.2.kamp: %1$sMy granny says when the Qi mist falls, folk dream of being kings.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.3: %1$sIn yesterday's mist I nearly walked into a lamp post. So embarrassing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.kabut.3.kasa: %1$sYesterday I walked into a lamp post in the mist. Don't laugh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.0: %1$sThe peach blossoms are out by the river. A good season for proposals, they say.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.0.kampu: %1$sThe peach blossoms are out, child. Proposal season.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.0.kuno: %1$sPeach blossoms bloom by the river. A fine season to bind vows.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.1: %1$sIn spring everyone turns diligent. Paddies, gardens, even the cats on the roofs.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.2: %1$sThe children fly kites again. The sky is full of paper dragons.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.2.air: %1$sKites reflected in the canal, dear... like dragons swimming...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.3: %1$sSpring like this, the air smells sweet. Makes me want to write poems, though I can't.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.4: %1$sThe swallows came back to our eaves this year. A sign of a harmonious household.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.semi.4.kuno: %1$sThe swallows returned to our eaves. The elders say it marks a harmonious home.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.0: %1$sSo hot this season. Even the crickets are too lazy to sing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.0.oasi: %1$sThis heat is nothing, friend. In the desert eggs cook on stones.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.1: %1$sThe watermelons from the east fields are sweet this year. Tried them?
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.1.kamp: %1$sThe east field melons are sweet, child. Shall I cut you one?
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.2: %1$sAt night I sleep on the veranda. Indoors is like an oven.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.2.pela: %1$sNights I sleep on deck, mate. The cabin's like an oven.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.3: %1$sSummer, the river shrinks. Many boatmen sit idle.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.3.air: %1$sThe canals are low, dear... the boats are stuck in mud...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.3.oasi: %1$sIn heat like this, friend, water is dearer than words.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.4: %1$sThe physician says drink chrysanthemum tea so inner heat won't rise.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.panas.4.kuno: %1$sChrysanthemum tea calms inner heat, so says the old physician.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.0: %1$sThe leaves are turning red. The moon festival is near.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.0.kuno: %1$sThe leaves redden. The moon festival is near; may families gather.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.1: %1$sAutumn is harvest. Everyone busy, everyone tired, everyone eating well.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.1.kamp: %1$sHarvest time, child! Tiring, but the new rice smells wonderful.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.2: %1$sThe autumn wind carries the smell of rice. I love it.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.2.gunu: %1$sThe autumn wind carries incense from the monastery. So peaceful.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.3: %1$sThis year's mooncakes: red bean or lotus seed? I'll take lotus.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.3.p: %1$sThis year I'm making mooncakes myself. Lotus filling, of course.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.4: %1$sAutumn always makes me think of those who have passed.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.gugur.4.kuno: %1$sAutumn always recalls those who have returned to heaven.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.0: %1$sA long winter this year. May the granary hold.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.0.kam: %1$sA long winter, child. May the village granary last.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.1: %1$sNew Year is almost here. I haven't bought red paper yet.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.1.p: %1$sNew Year's nearly here and I haven't sewn the children's clothes! Oh dear.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.2: %1$sMornings your breath turns to smoke. The children pretend to be dragons.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.2.kun: %1$sBreath becomes mist in the morning. The children play at young dragons.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.3: %1$sIn cold like this, bone soup at the eatery sells best.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.3.oas: %1$sDesert nights are freezing, friend. Mutton soup sells best.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.musim.dingin.4: %1$sMy hands are cracked from cold water. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.0: The morning market was packed. Someone was selling a fish the size of a child.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.0.pelabuh: The fish market was packed this morning, mate! A tuna the size of a child!%1$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.0.kuno: The morning market was teeming, %2$s. Someone sold a fish the size of a child.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.1: %1$sI overslept. The neighbour's rooster has a sore throat, apparently.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.1.kasar: %1$sOverslept. The neighbour's rooster didn't crow. Blame the rooster.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.2: %1$sMornings like this call for porridge and fried dough. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.2.kampung: %1$sMornings call for porridge and fritters, child. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.3: %1$sThe old men have done tai chi in the square since dawn. Slow as anything, but they never fall ill.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.3.gunung: %1$sThe old monks practise in the yard since dawn. Their moves are slow as clouds.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.4: %1$sToday's market day. The carts are already queued at the gate.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.pagi.4.oasis: %1$sMarket day, friend! The camels are queued at the oasis gate.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.0: %1$sAt this hour the teahouse is full of people pretending to be busy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.1: %1$sMy stomach's been growling a while. Has the bun seller passed yet?
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.1.kampun: %1$sMy belly's rumbling, child. Has the meatball seller passed yet?
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.2: %1$sHalf the day's gone. The other half is still long.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.2.kuno: %1$sHalf the day has passed. The other half still waits.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.3: %1$sHigh noon like this, even ghosts can't be bothered, they say.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.siang.3.kampun: %1$sBroad noon like this, granny says, even devils nap.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.0: %1$sEvenings the children play in the alleys. Noisy as a bird market.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.0.kasar: %1$sKids making a racket in the lane. Every evening.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.1: %1$sSoon the lanterns will be lit. I love when the town turns amber.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.1.air: %1$sSoon the canal lanterns will be lit, dear... the town turns amber... lovely...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.2: %1$sThe workers head home. Cooking smells from every kitchen. The best hour in town.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.2.kuno: %1$sThe workers go home and kitchen smoke rises. This is when the town breathes easy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.3: %1$sOn clear evenings the old men play chess under the tree till dark.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.sore.3.kampung: %1$sOn clear evenings the old folk play chess till dark.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.0: %1$sQuiet tonight. Too quiet, if you ask me.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.0.iblis: %1$sQuiet tonight. In this city, quiet means someone is sharpening a knife.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.1: %1$sThe night watchman just struck his clapper. Second watch already.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.1.kampun: %1$sThe slit drum's struck twice, child. It's late.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.2: %1$sHalf moon tonight. Good for stealing, the pickpockets say. Hehe, joking.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.2.kasar: %1$sHalf moon. Pickpockets love it. Mind your purse.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.3: %1$sThe tavern is still lively. Hear that? Someone singing off-key.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.jam.malam.3.pelabu: %1$sThe sailors' tavern is still lively, mate. Hear that? An off-key sea shanty.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.0.kasar: %1$s gets more crowded. Too many people.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.0.kuno: %1$s grows busier year by year; a sign fortune flows.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.1: The road out front's been mended. At last my cart doesn't jolt.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.1.kampun: The village road's been mended, child. My cart doesn't wobble now.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.2: Tried the pulled noodles in %1$s? They say they're the best in %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.2.kasar: The pulled noodles in %1$s are good. Go if you're hungry.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.3: More and more newcomers. Yesterday a group came from far off, in such odd clothes.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.3.oasis: Many newcomers pass this oasis, friend. Yesterday one wore silver robes.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.4: In %1$s everybody knows everybody's business. Mind what you say.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.4.kasar: Everyone here sticks their nose in. Careful.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.5: The well at the end of the street has the sweetest water. That's a secret.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.5.kampun: The well at the village end has the freshest water, child. That's a secret.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.6: New lanterns at the gate. Red and gold. Pretty.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.6.kuno: New lanterns adorn the gate, red-gold like dusk.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.7: The cats here are fatter than the people.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.8: Life in %1$s isn't lavish, but it's calm. That's enough.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.8.kuno: Life in %1$s isn't lavish, but tranquil. That's grace enough.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.8.iblis: Life here isn't calm, but at least it's honest: everyone's openly wicked.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.8.pelabu: Harbour life is like the waves, mate. Up, down, wet.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.9: The builders are putting up a new house on the end plot. Our town is growing.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.umum.9.kampun: Everyone's building a house at the end of the village, child. Our village grows.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.0: In the capital even the beggars wear silk sandals. Nearly.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.0.kas: The capital. Everyone shows off. Even beggars.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.1: Seen the palace from the main bridge? Its roofs gleam like molten gold.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.1.kun: From the main bridge the palace roofs gleam like molten gold, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.2: Here, if you want things done quickly, know the right official. Otherwise, wait three seasons.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.2.kas: Want it fast? Bribe. Want it slow? Follow the rules.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.3: The market district bustles from dawn to midnight. The capital never sleeps.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.ibukota.3.kun: The market district never sleeps; the capital breathes day and night.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.0: In this village, if anyone cooks meat, the whole village smells it.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.0.kas: Cook meat here? The whole village comes begging.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.1: The east paddies are good this year. Even the headman's buffalo got fat.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.1.kun: The east paddies flourish this year; even the headman's buffalo has fattened.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.2: Village life is simple, child. Wake, work, eat, sleep. Repeat.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.2.kas: Village life: work, eat, sleep. Boring.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.3: The bamboo bridge over the stream wobbles now. I hope someone fixes it.
kultivator.cakap.basa.kota.kampung.3.kun: The bamboo bridge over the stream wavers. May some hand deign to fix it.
kultivator.cakap.basa.tanya.perjalanan.0: Where did your road start today, %1$s? That dust on your boots isn't local.
Where're you from? Your dust isn't ours.
Where did your steps begin today, %1$s? The dust on your soles is from another land.
kultivator.cakap.basa.tanya.perjalanan.1: You must have seen many places, %1$s. I've never been outside %2$s.
You must have been everywhere, %1$s. I've never left %2$s, child.
kultivator.cakap.basa.tanya.perjalanan.2: Out there, are there truly floating mountains? I'm dying to know.
Is there truly an island floating in the sky, mate? The old sailors say so.
kultivator.cakap.basa.tanya.perjalanan.3: Do cultivators like you sleep, %1$s? Or only meditate?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.0: Come, come! Fresh %1$s, just in this morning!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.0.kuno: Please look, %2$s. The finest %1$s in all this mortal town.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.0.pelab: %1$s straight off the ship, mate! Still smells of the sea!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.0.oasis: %1$s from beyond the desert, friend. Fifty days by camel!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.0.air: %1$s, dear... from boat to your hand... so fresh...
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.0.kampu: %1$s from my own garden, child. No pest poison.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.1: %1$s, look at this %2$s. Only %3$s. Cheap, eh?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.1.iblis: %2$s. %3$s. You don't ask where it's from, I don't lie.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.2: For you, %1$s, today only, %2$s for just %3$s. Don't tell the others.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.2.kasar: %3$s today. Dearer tomorrow. Up to you.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.3: First customer today! Fortune's opener; I'll give you a good price.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.3.p: First customer! Oh, a good sign. Come, which one?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.4: Feel it. Tell the difference from the next market's goods yourself.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.5: Only a little %1$s left. The next caravan's a long way off.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawarkan.6: Looking's fine too. Looking's free; buying you pay. Hehe.
%1$s? Are you robbing me? %2$s, no more.
%1$s is too high for goods of this kind. %2$s is more fitting.
%1$s? By the spring! The next bazaar has it for %2$s, friend!
Oh, %1$s's too much, sir. %2$s, for a regular.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_pembeli.1: Yesterday at the east market it was only %1$s. Why dearer here?
At the next dock it's %1$s, mate. Don't think I just stepped off a boat.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_pembeli.2: I'll take two at %1$s. How's that?
I'll take two at %1$s. For my children. Have pity.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_pembeli.3: Look, there's a flaw here. %1$s at most.
It's flawed. %1$s. Take it or I walk.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_pembeli.4: I've been buying since your father traded here, you know. %1$s, for old times.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_penjual.0: %1$s? Oh, I'd lose money! %2$s, that's a friend's price already.
This humble one only seeks a bowl of rice, %3$s. %2$s is my limit.
%1$s? Funny. The last one who offered that didn't go home whole. %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_penjual.1: I've five mouths to feed. %1$s, can't go lower.
Three children, a sick husband. %1$s; have pity on me too.
Shipping's dear, mate! %1$s, profit's already cut.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_penjual.2: Fine, fine. Let's meet in the middle. %1$s.
For friendship's sake, friend. %1$s. I'm hurting myself here.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_penjual.3: You bargain well. %1$s, but tell no one.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_penjual.4: Goods like these cost double in the capital. %1$s is very cheap already.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.0: Done, agreed! %1$s. May your fortune flow!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.0.kuno: Agreement is reached. May these goods serve your path, %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.0.pelabu: Shake on it, mate! A sailor's deal can't be taken back!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.0.oasis: By the spring, agreed! May your caravan be safe, friend.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.0.kampun: Deal! Thank you, child. Drop by again.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.1: Thank you! I'll wrap it neatly.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.1.p: Thank you! A little extra, for a new regular.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.1.air: Thank you, dear... I hope you like it...
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.2: Customers like you brighten my day, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.sepakat.3: Done, done! Heaven witnesses, our trade is clean.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.0: Never mind, then. Too dear for me.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.0.kuno: Perhaps our fate does not lie with these goods. Another time.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.0.pelabuha: No deal, mate. I'll try another boat.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.0.oasis: No deal, friend. This bazaar is large.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.0.kampung: Fine, not buying. I'll make it myself.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.1: Well, if it can't go lower. I'll look elsewhere first.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.1.p: Oh well. Perhaps my husband can make one himself.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.2: Hmph. Your loss; I'm a loyal customer.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.3: I'll come back when the price drops.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.batal.3.iblis: I'll be back. With my friends.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.0: %1$sTrade's brisk today! The %2$s sold out before noon. %3$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.0.k: %1$sSelling well. Can finally pay the rent.
%1$sFortune overflows today. Heaven watches the diligent.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.0.p: %1$sWhole cargo's gone, mate! Drinks on me tonight!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.1: %1$sNew customers keep coming since the festival. I've had to get my child to help.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.1.p: %1$sNew customers keep coming. I even forgot to comb my hair. Hehe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.2: %1$sIf this keeps up, I could open a second stall.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.laris.3: %1$sProfit's better than last year. The ancestors must be blessing us.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.0: %1$sSo quiet today. Only two buyers since morning. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.0.ka: %1$sDead. Even the flies won't stop by.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.0.ku: The market is sluggish. Even spirit stones sleep in people's purses.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.0.pe: %1$sNo ships, no buyers, mate. I just stare at the sea.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.0.ka: %1$sQuiet, child. The village is all out in the paddies.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.1: The %1$s won't sell. Maybe I chose wrong this season.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.1.oa: %3$sCaravans pass without stopping, friend. My %1$s waits under the blazing sun.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.2: %1$sStall tax up, buyers down. How are small folk to live?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.3: %1$sIf this goes on, I'll have to borrow from the lender. Heaven forbid.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.cerita.sepi.3.ib: %1$sQuiet. In this city quiet means something bigger is eating the market.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.0: Do you know the price of %2$s in other towns, %1$s? Here it's getting absurd.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.0.ka: What's %2$s cost where you're from? Don't lie.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.0.ku: May I ask, %1$s, what %2$s costs in the lands you've passed?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.1: What are you buying today, %1$s? If it's %2$s, it's dear now.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.1.pe: Looking for what, mate? %2$s is dear; the ship's not in.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.2: Do you think %2$s will drop before the season turns, %1$s?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tanya_harga.3: %1$s is cheap now. Bought any? Store some for winter.
kultivator.cakap.seru.keluh.1.pelabuhan: Hah, you can't fight the waves.
kultivator.cakap.seru.keluh.5: Who knows how long this will last.
kultivator.cakap.seru.keluh.6: My head spins just thinking of it.
kultivator.cakap.seru.keluh.7.kuno: Let it pass with the wind.
kultivator.cakap.seru.keluh.9.pelabuhan: My purse is dry as a deck at noon, mate.
kultivator.cakap.seru.kaget.5.kuno: This one truly cannot believe it!
kultivator.cakap.seru.senang.2.oasis: The spring still flows for us.
kultivator.cakap.seru.senang.3: It gladdens my heart to hear it.
kultivator.cakap.seru.senang.6.pelabuhan: Now that's fresh news, like morning fish!
kultivator.cakap.seru.ragu.2: But that's only what people say.
kultivator.cakap.seru.ragu.2.ibukota: But it isn't on official record, mind.
kultivator.cakap.seru.ragu.7: You know how market mouths are.
kultivator.cakap.seru.ragu.7.pelabuhan: You know how dock mouths are.
kultivator.cakap.seru.ragu.7.oasis: You know how bazaar mouths are.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.0.kuno: May heaven and earth protect you, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.1.pelabuhan: May your winds be ever fair.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.1.oasis: May a spring always await you.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.2: May your fortune flow like a river.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.3: May your Qi stay ever clear.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.6: Long life and good health to you.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.6.kuno: May the Dao attend your every step.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.7: May you meet no bandits on the road.
kultivator.cakap.frag.doa.8.pelabuhan: May you return to port safe.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.0: As the old folk said, still waters run deep.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.0.kampung: As granny says, still waters run deep.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.1: Even a tall mountain is climbed one step at a time.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.2: One tree does not make a forest.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.2.kuno: One tree is no forest; one person is no sect.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.3: A sweet mouth does not mean a sweet heart.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.4: Who sows the wind reaps the storm.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.6: Money can be found; a good name once lost rarely returns.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.6.kuno: Wealth can be sought; a good name once stained is hard to restore.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.7: Above the sky there is another sky.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.8.oasis: A guest in the desert is a blessing of the spring.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.9: A tiger leaves its stripes, a man leaves his name.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.10: Even dripping water bores through stone.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.11: Don't sell the bear's hide before you've caught the bear.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.12.pelabuh: Slowly, so long as we make port.
kultivator.cakap.frag.pepatah.13: The early bird gets the worm.
kultivator.cakap.frag.katanya.7: at the well this morning folk said
kultivator.cakap.frag.penutup_kecil.2.ka: Blab, and I'll pull your tongue.
kultivator.cakap.frag.penutup_kecil.5.ku: The mortal world is full of oddities.
kultivator.cakap.frag.ajakan.0: Drop by my place some time.
kultivator.cakap.frag.ajakan.0.kampung: Drop by my hut some time, child.
kultivator.cakap.frag.ajakan.1.kuno: Someday we shall enjoy tea together.

kultivator.cakap.kabar.ranah.1.gunung: %1$sThe monks felt a tremor of Qi %3$s. They say %2$s broke through. Amitabha.

kultivator.cakap.kabar.sekte.1: %1$sWord is %2$s carries the name of %3$s. May that sect be kind to our town.%4$s

kultivator.cakap.kabar.menang_duel.0: Did you see the duel %1$s? %2$s beat %3$s in three moves!%4$s

kultivator.cakap.kabar.menyuap.0: Shh... %1$s slipped %2$s into %3$s's hand. I saw it myself.%4$s

kultivator.cakap.kabar.menyuap.1.ibukota: %1$sIn the capital everyone knows the price of a signature. %4$s paid %2$s %3$s.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.merayu.0: %1$sHehe, %2$s was sweet-talking %3$s by the well %4$s! Cheeks red as lanterns.%5$s

kultivator.cakap.kabar.dermawan.0: %1$s%2$s gave %3$s %4$s just like that! Without being asked! %5$s

kultivator.cakap.kabar.dermawan.1: %1$s%2$s could pay the physician thanks to %3$s. A good soul, truly.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.dermawan.1.oasis: %1$sLike rain in the desert, friend. %3$s gave %2$s %5$s.%4$s

kultivator.cakap.kabar.dermawan.3: %1$sThe beggars at the gate say %2$s's name in their prayers.%3$s
