kultivator.cakap.kabar.berkelahi.1.pelab: %1$s%2$s and %3$s fought on the dock, mate. Both fell in the sea. Cooled their heads.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.berkelahi.1.iblis: %1$s%2$s versus %3$s? That's no fight. Nobody died.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.berkelahi.2: %1$sThey say they quarrelled over the price of %2$s. So petty, but that's people.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.berkelahi.3: %1$s%2$s's family is still fuming since the fight with %3$s.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.berkelahi.3.p: %1$s%2$s's mother dragged them home by the ear after the fight with %3$s. Hehe.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.0: %1$s%2$s got roaring drunk %3$s. Sang on the rooftop till dawn!%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s's drunk again. A sot is a sot.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.0.kuno: %1$sWine drowned %2$s's wits %3$s. Self-control is the root of the path.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.1: %1$s%2$s slept in the pigsty all night. Even the pig moved out. Hahaha!%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.1.pelabuhan: %1$s%2$s got drunk and hugged the mast, mate. Called it their sweetheart.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.1.kampung: %1$s%2$s got drunk on palm wine and went into the wrong house. The headman's! What a fuss.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.2: %1$sThe tavern keeper kept %2$s's sandals as surety. The wine bill is unpaid.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.mabuk.3: %1$sI told you not to drink with %2$s. They don't know when to stop. %3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.0: %1$s%2$s lost %3$s at the dice table %4$s. The family doesn't know yet. Shh.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s lost at gambling again. Idiot. Every one of those dice is weighted.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.0.kuno: %1$sThe gambling hunger gnaws at %2$s. %3$s vanished in one night.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.1: %1$s%2$s sold the hoe to gamble. How will they work tomorrow? %3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.1.iblis: %1$s%2$s lost %4$s in the gambling den. The house smiled. The house always smiles.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.1.pelabuhan: %1$sThree months' sea wages, mate, gone at the dice by %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.judi.2: %1$sThey say %2$s swore off gambling. That's the tenth oath.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.0: %1$s%2$s's child was accepted by %3$s! Good spirit roots, the examiner said.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s joined %3$s. Soon they'll forget their own home.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.0.kuno: %1$s%2$s has stepped through the gate of %3$s. May their Dao be long.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.1: %1$s%2$s left for %3$s %4$s. The mother wept; the father boasted to everyone.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.1.kampun: %1$sA child of our village joined %3$s! %2$s! Imagine, from paddy to sect.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.1.gunung: %1$s%2$s left the monastery for %3$s. The monks sent them off with prayers.%5$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.2: %1$sSince %2$s joined %3$s, the family no longer pays land tax. Lucky.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.direkrut.3: %1$sI want my child's roots tested too. Who knows, maybe into %3$s like %2$s.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.0: %2$s's %1$s is booming. The queue reaches the street corner.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.0.kasar: %4$s%2$s got rich overnight. The %1$s is booming. Walks like an official now.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.0.kuno: %4$sFortune flows into %2$s's %1$s. Hard work bears sweet fruit.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.1: %1$sTry %3$s's %2$s. Everyone says it's the best in town.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.1.pelabuhan: %3$s's %2$s is full of sailors every night, mate. Busy as a monsoon port.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.1.oasis: %1$sCaravans stop at %3$s's %2$s. Selling like cold water at noon.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.laris.2: %1$s%2$s even took on two new hands. The %3$s is swamped.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.0.kasar: %5$s%2$s went bust. That's how trading without brains ends.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.0.kuno: %5$sThe wheel of fate turns. %2$s's %1$s is silent now.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.1: %1$s%2$s is selling the %3$s's furniture cheap. If you need a table, now's the time.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.1.iblis: %2$s's %3$s was seized by collectors. In this city, fall once and you fall for good.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.1.kampun: %1$s%2$s's stall shut. Lovely fried rice, too. Everyone bought on credit, that's why.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.2: %1$s %2$s got so deep in debt the %3$s had to be sold. %4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.bangkrut.3: %1$sI hope %2$s rises again. They're tough, after all.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.0: %1$s%2$s reckons this town used to be better. I don't know whether to agree.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s says every official is crooked. Well, not wrong.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.0.kuno: %1$s%2$s holds that heaven is testing this town. A view worth pondering.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.1: %1$s%2$s is sure the gate tax is too high. Grumbles again every time someone passes.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.1.ibukota: %1$s%2$s wrote to the minister's office about taxes. No answer yet.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.2: %1$s%2$s says the town's protector sect never truly cares. Some agree, some are furious.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.opini.3: %1$s%2$s says young folk are lazy now. Though their mother says they were the same.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.0: Hic... that moon... two? No, one... drink with me, friend!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.0.kas: Hic. Move. The road's swaying on its own.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.0.kun: Hic... this wine... opens the meridians... they say...
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.0.pel: Hic! The ship's rolling, mate... oh, this is land.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.1: The wine next door... hic... is watered. But I still got drunk. Impressive, eh?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.1.kam: Old Darmo's palm wine is the best, hic... tomorrow my head will pound...
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.2: My wife... hic... waits at home with a broom. I'll go home... later.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemabuk.2.p: My husband mustn't know, hic... I only drank... two jugs...
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kakek_catur.0: Do you play chess? No? A pity. Every opponent here cheats.
Don't stand behind me. Your shadow covers the board.
Chess teaches that every pawn can become a general, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kakek_catur.1: Thirty years of chess under this tree. Lost once, won ten thousand times.
The headman lost to me at chess yesterday, child. Still sulking.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kakek_catur.2: Knight here... no, there. Hm. Don't disturb me, I'm thinking.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.gosip_sumur.0: The well was so busy just now. You won't believe what I heard.
The well's the source of all news. And water, sometimes.
The well is the mothers' council hall, %1$s. No secret survives there.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.gosip_sumur.1: I draw water three times a day. Not because I need water. Hehe.
The spring spout is where every story is, child. The bucket's just an excuse.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.gosip_sumur.2: If you want to know anything about this town, come to the well early.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.burung_sangka: Hear that song? I bought this bird from a southern trader. It sounds like a flute.
Don't come close. My bird fears strangers.
Even a caged bird sings, %1$s. That's a lesson about the heart.
Every morning I take the cage for a walk. Birds need to see the world too.
There's a songbird contest next week. Mine will surely win. Fed it the best grubs.
This bird was a gift from my late husband. Whenever it sings, I remember him.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tai_chi.0: Join the tai chi? Slowly now. Breathe in, breathe out.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tai_chi.0.kun: Slow movement calms the Qi, %1$s. Even mortals can feel it.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tai_chi.1: I'm seventy, yet my knees are strong. The secret: tai chi every dawn.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tai_chi.1.gun: The young monks learn from me. But they're too fast. Always rushing.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tai_chi.2: This move is called drifting clouds. Follow my hands.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemancing.0: Shh... the fish nearly took the bait. Don't make noise.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemancing.0.k: Go away. My fish fled because of you.
Fishing isn't about fish, %1$s. It's about waiting without fretting.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemancing.1: All day here and only one catch. A small one too. But peaceful.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemancing.1.a: The fish in this canal are so clever, dear... eat the bait, leave the hook...
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemancing.2: Yesterday I nearly landed a carp as big as my arm. Truly! The line snapped.
Look at my cricket! Black General. Never lost!
Want a bet? Two coins. My cricket's sure to win.
Even a little cricket has a warrior's spirit, %1$s.
Won three times at the dice last night. Tonight for sure again!
Gambling den in the back alley. The house is honest. By this city's standards.
My wife hid my cricket. Says I love it more than her. Heh.
My husband hid my cricket. Says I love it more than him. Hehe.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyair.0: The moon above the pond, its image shattered by the wind... ah, how does it go on?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyair.1: Tonight's opera is about a loyal consort. I've seen it seven times and still weep.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyair.1.air: The canal at night makes me want to write poems, dear... listen...
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyair.2: I write a poem for each season. %1$s is the hardest.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemain_erhu.0: This song is about parting on a bridge. Listen, the strings weep.
Don't ask for a cheerful tune. I don't know any.
The erhu has only two strings, yet it voices a thousand sorrows.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemain_erhu.1: My father played erhu. My grandfather too. This tune has come down three generations.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemain_erhu.2: If you've a coin, drop it in the bowl. If not, just listen. Music's free for the heart.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pendoa.0: I've just come from the temple. Today's fortune is good for you too, I think.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pendoa.0.kasa: Don't step on my shadow. Bad luck.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pendoa.0.kuno: The gods hear, %1$s. Only their answers are often late.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pendoa.1: Never sweep the house on new year's day. Your luck gets swept out too!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pendoa.1.kamp: When a crow caws three times, someone's going to die, child. Beware.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pendoa.2: I brought charms from the temple. Want one? For safety on the road.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.layang.0: Good wind today! My kite could fly up to touch the clouds!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.layang.0.kasa: Don't pull the string! It'll snap!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.layang.0.kuno: A kite flies high by resisting the wind, not following it.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.layang.1: The children wait for my story every afternoon. Today it's the rabbit on the moon.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.layang.2: I made this dragon kite in three days. Its tail is as long as the street!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyulam.0: This embroidery is a crane above clouds. A month in, still not done.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyulam.0.ka: Don't touch. The thread is costly.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyulam.0.ku: Every needle stroke is patience woven, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyulam.1: This is for my daughter's dowry. It must be perfect, not one crooked thread.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyulam.2: The fan dance needs a supple wrist. Look. Like a butterfly.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tidur_siang.0: Yaaawn... midday's the best time for a nap. Aren't you sleepy?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tidur_siang.1: Work? Later. The sun's too hot for working.
Full belly, sleepy eyes, child. That's what we call a blessing.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.tidur_siang.2: This bench is the comfiest in town. I've tried them all.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pesolek.0: My hair's neat, isn't it? An hour combing this morning.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pesolek.0.kas: Don't look at me in those dirty clothes.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pesolek.0.kun: Appearance mirrors the heart, %1$s. Mine is spotless, naturally. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pesolek.1: This silk is from the finest weaver. See it shine in the sun.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pesolek.1.l: This new hat makes every girl turn. Just watch.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pesolek.2: Rain? No! My powder will run!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pelit.0: Money doesn't grow on trees. I keep every coin.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pelit.0.kasar: Want to borrow money? No. Don't ask again.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pelit.0.kuno: Thrift is the root of wealth, %1$s. My forebears hoarded spirit stones for three generations.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pelit.1: I've brewed these leaves four times. Still some taste left.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pelit.1.kampu: My clothes are all patches, child. But my piggy bank is full. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pelit.2: Why buy when you can borrow? Why borrow when you can wait for someone to throw it out?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.dermawan.0: I hand out porridge at the gate every morning. Want to help?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.dermawan.0.ka: Don't tell anyone I give. Everyone will come.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.dermawan.0.ku: What we give returns, %1$s. Perhaps not in this life.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.dermawan.1: The harvest is good this year. I'm sharing some with those in need.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.dermawan.2: Folk say I'm too kind. But what use is being rich alone?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemarah.0: What?! Oh, you. Thought it was the kids throwing stones again.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemarah.0.kas: Out of the way! Everyone's slow today!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemarah.0.kun: My patience has been tested since dawn, %1$s. Pray don't add to it.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemarah.1: My neighbour's been chopping wood since dawn! It's like it's inside my skull!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemarah.1.kam: The neighbour's hens are in my garden again! I'll slaughter them one day!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemarah.2: Prices up, taxes up, my blood pressure too!
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kutu_buku.0: Sorry, I wasn't looking. This chapter is too gripping.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kutu_buku.0.k: In books there are golden houses and jade faces, says an old saying.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kutu_buku.1: This book is about a swordsman who lost his memory. I've read it three times.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kutu_buku.2: If you have a book I haven't read, %1$s, I'd trade anything for it.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kucing.0: Puss, puss... Ah, those are my cats. Seven, all named.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kucing.0.kasa: Don't kick that cat. Or I'll kick you.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kucing.0.kuno: Cats know who's kind-hearted, %1$s. Look, it's coming to you.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kucing.1: Stripy gave birth last night. Five kittens. Want one?
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.kucing.2: The fishmonger gives me scraps every evening. For the cats, of course.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyapu.0: I sweep this road every morning. Clean road, clean heart.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyapu.0.kas: Don't drop rubbish here. I just swept.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyapu.0.kun: Sweeping fallen leaves is a mortal's meditation, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyapu.1: So many leaves this %1$s. I sweep, the wind brings them back.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.penyapu.2: Work is medicine. If I sit still, I fall ill.
What shall I draw in sugar? A dragon? A phoenix? Just one coin!
The sugar melts, but the picture stays in children's memories.
This tea's from the northern slopes. Brew it just off the boil, never boiling.
The children love rabbits most. Easy to draw, quickly licked away. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pengintip.0: I'm not peeping. I'm... observing the neighbourhood. That's different.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pengintip.0.k: What? Just looking. Not forbidden, is it?
A watchful eye sees what is hidden, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pengintip.1: The neighbour gets visitors every night. I know; I count.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pengintip.2: From this window I see the whole lane. Nothing slips past.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.pemuja_kultiv: You're a cultivator, aren't you, %1$s? May I hold your sword? Just a moment!
A cultivator! Teach me! I'll pay! Anything!
It's a great honour to speak with a Dao walker like you, %1$s.
I collect the tales of every cultivator who passes this town. Tell me yours!
Mister, mister! Sign my stick, please! So my friends believe!
I've been practising breathing from a manual I bought at market. Haven't felt anything yet, though.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.0: %1$s%2$s is at home cooking. Best cooking in this lane.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.0.kun: %1$s%2$s is my life's companion. Without them this house is only walls.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.0.l: %1$sMy wife, %2$s, is fierce but kind. Come home late and plates fly. Heh.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.0.p: %1$sMy husband, %2$s, is quiet. But every morning he readies warm water for me.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.1: %1$sTwenty years with %2$s. They still make me laugh.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.1.kam: %1$s%2$s and I were matched by our parents, child. Shy at first, inseparable now.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.1.pel: %1$s%2$s waits on the dock every time I come home from sea, mate. Every time.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.1.air: %1$s%2$s loves rowing with me at night... the canal belongs to just us two...%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.2: %1$s%2$s sent me for salt, but here I am chatting. Don't tell.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.2.p: %1$s%2$s is waiting for me, but let him wait a bit. Men need practice waiting too. Hehe.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.3: %1$sWe quarrelled yesterday over a small thing. Made up, but I'm still embarrassed.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.pasangan.4: %1$sIf you ask the secret of a lasting marriage: eat together every night, whatever happens.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.0: %1$s%2$s has started learning to read. Yesterday they read a shop sign all alone!%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s is a terror. But clever. Takes after me.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.0.kuno: %1$sMy child, %2$s, studies diligently. May they serve the town someday.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.0.kampung: %1$s%2$s can herd the goats now, child. I'm proud.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.1: %1$s%2$s wants to be a cultivator. Swings a stick like a sword every day.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.1.pelabuh: %1$s%2$s swims further than me now, mate! A true child of the sea.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.1.p: %1$s%2$s helped me cook this morning. The porridge burned, but the thought was sweet.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.2: %1$s%2$s had a bellyache yesterday; ate three green guavas. I told them!%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.3: %1$sIf any cultivator would test %2$s's spirit roots, I'd gladly pay.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.3.kuno: %1$sIf you would deign to examine %2$s's spirit roots, %4$s, I'd be most grateful.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.anak.4: %1$sTime flies. Yesterday %2$s was in arms, now running everywhere.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.0: I have seven grandchildren. Sometimes I mix up their names. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.0.kasar: My grandchildren are noisy. But the house is dead without them.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.0.kuno: Watching grandchildren grow is old age's greatest reward.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.0.kampung: Granny here has seven grandkids, child. The littlest is the naughtiest.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.1: Once I carried %1$s. Now %1$s leads me to market.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.1.p: Once I spoon-fed %1$s. Now %1$s cooks my porridge.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.2: My knees aren't strong, but when a grandchild asks to be carried, I still lift them.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.3: I'm eighty. Heaven still gives me time, who knows what for. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.cucu.3.gunung: I've passed eighty winters. This monastery has been my home longer than anyone's.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.0: Sorry, I can't talk long. %1$s was just laid to rest.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.0.kun: %1$s has passed on. This house feels too large now.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.0.kam: %1$s is gone, child. I work the paddies alone now.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.1: Every morning I still call %1$s's name. Then I remember. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.1.p: %1$s's clothes are still folded in the chest. I can't bear to give them away.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.1.pel: The sea took %1$s, mate. I look at the sea differently now.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.2: %1$s used to sit on that bench. Now no one dares sit there.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.3: I burn spirit money for %1$s every month. May they want for nothing there.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.almarhum.3.gun: The monks prayed for %1$s forty-nine days. Amitabha.
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.0: %1$sDon't tell anyone... %2$s and I often meet on the bridge.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.0.kasa: Yes, %2$s and me. So? Got a problem?
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.0.kuno: %1$sMy heart and %2$s's have found each other. Only the families' blessing remains.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.0.air: %1$s%2$s writes poems on lotus leaves for me, dear... then floats them to my boat...%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.1: %1$s%2$s gave me this yesterday. Pretty, isn't it? Hehe.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.1.l: %1$s%2$s sewed this purse for me. The stitches are crooked, but I love it.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.1.kamp: %1$s%2$s sends guavas through their little sibling every evening. Mother suspects, child.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.2: %1$s%2$s's parents don't know yet. I'm afraid they won't approve.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.kekasih.3: %1$sWhen I've saved enough I'll propose to %2$s. A little more.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.0: %1$s%2$s and I have been friends since childhood. We used to steal guavas together. Heh.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.0.kasa: %1$s%2$s? The only person in this town who isn't irritating.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.0.kuno: %1$sMy friendship with %2$s is firmer than mountain stone.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.0.pela: %1$s%2$s once pulled me from the sea in a storm, mate. More than blood kin.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.1: %1$sTonight I'm having tea with %2$s. Come along if you like.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.1.p: %1$sThis afternoon I'm sewing with %2$s. And gossiping, of course. Hehe.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.2: %1$s%2$s knows all my secrets. If they wished, I'd be ruined. Luckily they're kind.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.sahabat.3: %1$sWhen I fall ill, %2$s is the first to come. Always.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.0: %1$sLook, %2$s is passing. My chickens went missing since they moved next door.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s. Tch. If they died tomorrow, I'd throw a party.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.0.kuno: %1$sBetween %2$s and me lies an old grievance. Better not discussed.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.0.kampun: %1$sThat's %2$s. Moved my paddy bund once. Still hasn't apologised.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.1: %1$sDon't buy from %2$s. The scales cheat. I'm not lying.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.1.iblis: %1$s%2$s owes me a blood debt. If you see them hurt in an alley, don't help.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.2: %1$sEvery time I open my stall, %2$s opens one opposite. On purpose!%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.musuh.3: %1$s%2$s and I were friends once. Then money came between us. %3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.0: %1$sMy master, %2$s, is very strict. But all I know, they taught me.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.0.kasar: %1$s%2$s is harsh. My hands are bruised from the cane. But I learned.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.0.kuno: %1$sThe kindness of my master, %2$s, is high as mountains and deep as seas.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.1: %1$sMy pupil, %2$s, is gifted. Soon they'll surpass me. And that makes me proud.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.1.kasar: %1$s%2$s is slow. But never gives up. That's enough.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.1.pelabuh: %1$s%2$s can read the stars now, mate. Next year they take the helm.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.2: %1$s%2$s says I must start again from scratch. Three years! But they're right.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.guru.3: %1$sTeaching %2$s reminds me of when I was a fool myself. Heh.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.0: When I grow up I'll be a cultivator! Fly above the clouds and slay dragons!
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.0.kasar: I want to be strong. So nobody dares mock me again.
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.0.kuno: I wish to tread the path of the Dao and see heaven's summit.
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.0.p: I want to be a healer! So my grandma stops coughing.
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.0.kampung: I want to be like you, %1$s! Have a sword and fly!
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.1: I want the biggest cake shop in town. Everyone eats free on rest days!
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.1.pelabuhan: I want to be a captain! My own ship, sailing to the end of the world!
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.1.oasis: I want to lead a caravan across the greatest desert! A hundred camels!
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.2: Father wants me to be a smith. But I want to be a storyteller. Is that allowed?
kultivator.cakap.cita.anak.3: I want to join a sect! I practise horse stance every morning. Look!
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.0: A dream? Simple. A roof that doesn't leak and children with full bellies.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.0.kasar: Dreams are for the rich. I just want to reach tomorrow.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.0.kuno: I wish to leave a good name. A tiger leaves its stripes.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.0.pelabuhan: A boat of my own, mate. Just one. Needn't be big.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.0.oasis: I want to see the sea once before I die, friend. They say there's as much water as sand.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.1: I'm saving to open my own teahouse. Just a little more.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.1.p: I want my child to study and become an official. So they don't struggle like their mother.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.1.ibukota: Pass the state exam and serve at the palace. Failed three times, but this year for sure.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.2: I once wanted to be a cultivator. No spirit roots. So now I make buns. Not bad.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.3: Clear my debts, then go home and plant peaches. That's all.
kultivator.cakap.cita.dewasa.3.kampung: I'd love to pilgrimage to the mountain temple once in my life, child. Pray for me.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.0: A dream? At my age? Heh. To see my grandchild wed, that's all.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.0.kasar: Die in peace. Debt-free. That's my dream.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.0.kuno: I only wish to see once more the mountain where I was born.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.0.gunung: To reach enlightenment before the last bell. Amitabha. Still far off.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.1: I once wanted to travel the world. Now going round the market tires me out. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.2: I'd like to write down this town's stories before I forget. But my hands shake.
kultivator.cakap.cita.tua.3: May this town stay peaceful after I'm gone.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.0: %1$sToday's work is heavy. My back feels hammered.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.0.kuno: %1$sIt's the sweat of small folk that holds the town up, %3$s.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.0.kampung: %1$sBeen hoeing since dawn, child. My hips feel ready to fall off.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.0.pelabuh: %1$sLoading since dawn, mate. The salt sacks weigh a ton.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.1: %1$sThe foreman says finish before dark and there's extra pay. I hope so.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.1.oasis: %1$sThe caravan foreman promised extra water if we finish before the heat, friend.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.2: %1$sHard work's fine, as long as the children eat.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.2.p: %1$sHard work's fine. What matters is the children go to school.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.3: %1$sMy hands are all calluses, but look: I built that wall.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pekerja.4: %1$sA short rest first. Push too hard and you can't get up tomorrow.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.0: %1$sTrade's like weather, %2$s. Sometimes clear, sometimes storm.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.0.kuno: %1$sBuying and selling is this one's path, %2$s. Not as high as the Dao, but honest.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.0.oasis: %1$sAt the bazaar, every coin has a story, friend.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.1: %1$sI sold more %2$s than usual today. Maybe a good sign.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.1.pelabu: %1$sThe %2$s from yesterday's ship sold like mad, mate.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.2: %1$sA loyal customer is treasure. One loyal customer beats ten passers-by.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.3: %1$sWant town news, ask a merchant. We hear it all from buyers.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.3.p: %1$sWant town news, ask me. Lady customers tell me everything. Hehe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pedagang.4: %1$sMy father traded at this same stall. My grandfather too. Three generations here.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.0: %1$sAll's safe, %2$s. While I stand here, nobody tries anything.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.0.kuno: %1$sThis spear has guarded the gate twenty years. Never once retreated.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.0.ibukota: %1$sCapital security runs three layers deep, %2$s. Nothing slips through.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.1: %1$sLast night someone tried scaling the east wall. We drove them off before they got down.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.1.pelabuh: %1$sLast night a boat with no lantern crept to the dock. We drove it off with fire arrows.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.2: %1$sStanding all day is harder than it looks. My feet are swollen.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.3: %1$sThe captain says night rounds are doubled. Word of spirit beasts in the woods.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.penjaga.4: %1$sThe pay is small, but if the town's safe I can sleep easy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.0: %1$sThis town was once ten houses. I remember when the main road was mud.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.0.kasar: %1$sYoung folk today don't know how hard it was.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.0.kuno: %1$sAge teaches patience, %3$s. And aching knees. Heh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.0.kampung: %1$sGranny's seen three headmen come and go, child. This one's not bad.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.1: %1$sFolk still come to me for advice. Though I often forget lunch.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.1.gunung: %1$sI've swept this monastery yard since youth. The leaves never run out. Amitabha.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.2: %1$sWhen there's a quarrel in the lane, folk bring it to me before the magistrate.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tetua.3: %1$sMy legs can't walk far now. So I sit here and watch the world go by.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.0: %1$sThe Qi in this town is thin. Meditating here is like drinking from a leaky cup.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.0.kasa: %1$sDon't disturb me. I'm settling my Qi.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.0.kuno: %1$sThe road of the Dao is long, %3$s. Only a step each day.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.0.ibli: %1$sMy blood art needs materials. This city is full of them. Joking. Perhaps.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.1: %1$sI came down the mountain to buy pill ingredients. Cheaper here than the sect market.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.1.gunu: %1$sThe monks let me meditate in the cave behind. The Qi there is clean.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.2: %1$sThe blockage in my third meridian still won't open. Maybe I need a pill.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.3: %1$sA cultivator who forgets mortals loses their roots. My master said so.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kultivator.3.kuno: %1$sA cultivator who forgets the mortal world is uprooted. Thus my master taught.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.0: %1$sI'm copying an old book. The ink has faded, and so have my eyes.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.0.kasar: %1$sDon't touch that scroll. It's a thousand years old.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.0.kuno: %1$sLearning is a lamp on a dark road, %3$s. Every book is its oil.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.0.ibukot: %1$sThe state exam is in two months. I'm memorising three hundred classic poems.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.1: %1$sDid you know this town once had another name, %2$s? It's in the old dynasty records.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.1.gunung: %1$sThe monastery library keeps sutras no outsider has ever read.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.2: %1$sThe schoolchildren prefer play to memorising. So did I once.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.cendekia.3: %1$sIf you have questions on history, just ask. I love being asked.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.0: %1$sThe morning incense is lit. May this town be at peace today.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.0.kuno: %1$sEvery prayer is a seed, %3$s. Its growing is not our concern.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.0.gunung: Amitabha. Morning bell, sweep the yard, noon sutras. So every day.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.1: %1$sMany come to pray lately. A sign that hearts are uneasy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.1.pelabuhan: %1$sThe sailors bring offerings before sailing. The sea god must be coaxed.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.2: %1$sThe temple needs a new roof before the rains. If you wish to give alms, %2$s...%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.rahib.3: %1$sYesterday someone came and wept all night. I sat with them. That too is prayer.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.0: %1$sTax reports pile on my desk. This town grows faster than my ink.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.0.kasar: %1$sIf you've a complaint, come to the office. There's a queue.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.0.kuno: %1$sGoverning is shouldering a mountain, %3$s. One lapse and the people are crushed.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.0.ibukota: %1$sThe minister wants reports before the full moon. We work late into the night.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.1: %1$sThe west bridge needs repair. The town treasury is thin, but I'll manage.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.2: %1$sFolk think officials live easy. Try sitting in my chair for a day.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pejabat.3: %1$sIf any townsfolk have complaints, I'll listen. Directly, not through middlemen.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.0: %1$sMother told me to mind my little brother. But he's asleep, so I'm playing!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.0.kasar: What do you want? I'm busy playing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.0.kuno: %1$sMother says good children help at home. I already swept!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.0.kampung: %1$sI've been herding ducks, mister! Thirty of them!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.1: %1$sThe teacher at school is fierce. Write it wrong and you stand in the corner.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.1.pelabuhan: %1$sI help Father dry fish! My hands stink, smell! Hehe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.2: %1$sI've got a secret: there's a bird's nest on the temple roof. Three eggs!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.anak.3: Want to play tops? I'm the best in the lane!%1$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.0: %1$sMy work isn't ordinary, %2$s. But someone has to do it.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.0.kasar: %1$sDon't ask what I do. Safer for you.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.0.kuno: %1$sEveryone has a role under heaven. Mine is somewhat... particular.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.0.iblis: %1$sI solve people's problems. In ways that aren't asked about.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.1: %1$sPeople rarely greet me. So thank you for stopping.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.2: %1$sQuiet today. When it's quiet, my work has succeeded.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.khusus.3: %1$sI see a lot in this town that others don't.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.0: %1$sThis iron is stubborn. Forged it three times and it still won't straighten.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.0.kasar: %1$sDon't stand near the forge unless you want to be scorched.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.0.kuno: %1$sA good blade is born of fire, water and patience, %3$s.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.0.kampung: %1$sThe headman's hoe broke again. He thinks the soil is river stone.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.1: %1$sThe ring of this hammer is like my own heartbeat now.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.1.iblis: %1$sMy blades have drunk the blood of a hundred. Not swung by me, of course.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.2: %1$sIf you have a cracked weapon, %2$s, bring it here. I'll mend it like new.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pandai.3: %1$sCharcoal's dear now. The forge must burn, profit or loss.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.0: %1$sThe rice is good this year. Without pests, the granary will be full.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.0.kasar: %1$sHard soil, late rain. Farmers always lose.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.0.kuno: %1$sThe earth gives to the patient, %3$s. Today's seed is next season's rice.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.0.kampung: %1$sThe grain's gone gold, child. Harvest next week. Come help?
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.1: %1$sThose sparrows are greedier than the tax collector. Heh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.1.gunung: %1$sThe tea leaves on this slope are hand-picked, one by one. That's why they're fragrant.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.2: %1$sMy buffalo is old. Like me. We work slowly together.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.petani.3: %1$sIf it rains tonight, I plant tomorrow. If not, I wait again.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.0: %1$sThe fish have moved to deep water. A sign the sea will turn cold.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.0.kuno: %1$sThe sea gives and takes, %3$s. A fisher only learns to accept.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.0.pelabuh: %1$sNot bad this morning, mate! A tuna big as a calf!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.0.air: %1$sThe canal fish are small, dear... but sweet when grilled...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.1: %1$sNew moon, the fish rise. Tonight I'm at sea till dawn.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.2: %1$sMy boat is old but still faithful. Like a good dog.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.nelayan.3: %1$sIf the gulls are loud at dawn, don't sail. A storm is near.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.0: %1$sI've simmered the broth since dawn. The secret is bones and patience.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.0.kasar: %1$sSit or get out. A kitchen isn't for watching.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.0.kuno: %1$sGood food calms the Qi, %3$s. Even cultivators get hungry.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.0.oasis: %1$sMutton with desert spices, friend. Fifty spices, my grandmother's recipe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.1: %1$sThe customer earlier said too salty. Yesterday he asked for more salt!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.1.p: %1$sMy mooncakes sold out before noon. Tomorrow I'll make double.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.2: %1$sTea from the first spring leaves. Smell it. Fragrant, isn't it?
kultivator.cakap.kerja.koki.3: %1$sThe upstairs rooms are all full. A caravan came last night.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.0: %1$sMany are coughing this season. The ginger and honey remedy keeps selling out.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.0.kuno: %1$sBodily illness is rooted in unbalanced Qi, %3$s.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.0.gunung: %1$sHerbs from these mountain cliffs work best. But picking them can kill.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.1: %1$sA minor healing pill, five coins. Cheap for a life, no?
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.1.iblis: %1$sMy medicine heals. Or the opposite. Depends who's paying.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.2: %1$sMy pill furnace exploded again yesterday. My eyebrows haven't grown back. Heh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.tabib.3: %1$sIf you're hurt, %2$s, don't be shy to come. Small wounds grow if neglected.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.0: %1$sThirtieth sack today. Twenty more to go.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.0.kasar: %1$sOut of the way! Heavy load coming!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.0.kuno: %1$sThese shoulders have carried half the town, %3$s. Still strong.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.0.gunung: %1$sThere are a thousand and eight steps to the monastery. I climb them three times a day.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.0.oasis: %1$sThis camel is cleverer than my foreman, friend. Knows when to stop drinking.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.1: %1$sWhen caravans come, porters eat well. When not, we eat air.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.2: %1$sToday's pay covers buns and tea. Tomorrow I find more.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kuli.3: %1$sMy back's never been straight since. But my children grow tall. That's enough.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.0: %1$sTonight I tell of the Monkey King at the teahouse. Come!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.0.kuno: %1$sEvery tale is a mirror, %3$s. The listener sees themself.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.0.oasis: %1$sThe desert dance tells of wind and sand, friend. Watch at the bonfire later.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.1: %1$sYesterday the crowd threw so many coins. Today it's empty. That's the artist's life.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.1.p: %1$sI'm practising a new fan dance. If I slip, the fan flies onto the roof. Hehe.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.2: %1$sThis erhu was my master's. I've changed the strings seven times, but it still sounds like him.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.hiburan.3: %1$sChildren love plate tricks. Old folk love sad tales. I prepare both.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.0: %1$sOthers sleep, I keep watch. The moon is bright tonight, so it's easy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.0.kasar: %1$sDon't wander at night. I'll mistake you for a thief.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.0.kuno: %1$sThe night has its own voice, %3$s. A watchman learns to hear it.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.0.pelabuhan: %1$sThe lighthouse must burn till dawn, mate. One dark night, one wreck.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.1: %1$sThe second watch is past. Three more strikes of the drum, then sleep.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.2: %1$sThat black cat keeps me company every night. My only friend at this hour.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.malam.3: %1$sThe town's ward formation must be checked every night. A small crack and beasts get in.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.0: %1$sI matched five couples this season! Heaven is pleased with me.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.0.kasar: %1$sSingle? At your age, still single? Come here, I'll find someone.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.0.kuno: %1$sThe red thread can't be forced, %3$s. But it can be nudged. Heh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.1: %1$sIf you're seeking a match, %2$s, I have a list. A very long one.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.1.kampun: %1$sThere's a good girl at the end of the village, child. Cooks well, hardworking. Shall I introduce you?
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.2: %1$sEven mourning rites must be done properly. Life begins and ends with ceremony.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.comblang.3: %1$sA couple I matched last year has a baby now. That's my best payment.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.0: %1$sJust one coin, %2$s... for a bowl of porridge...%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.0.kasar: %1$sWhat are you staring at? Not giving, then go.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.0.kuno: %1$sThis one once had a house too, %2$s. Fate turns like a wheel.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.1: %1$sThe gate walkers are stingy today. Maybe because of the rain.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.1.iblis: %1$sI know every rat-run in this city. Information costs more than porridge.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.2: %1$sIf you want to know who goes in and out tonight, ask me. My eyes are always open.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pengemis.3: %1$sI was a merchant once. Then one bad season. Now this.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.guru_sekolah.0: %1$sMy pupils learned to write their own names today. Three wrote the chicken's name.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.guru_sekolah.0.ka: %1$sThose children! Easier to teach a buffalo.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.guru_sekolah.0.ku: %1$sEducating children is planting trees whose fruit we'll never pick.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.guru_sekolah.1: %1$sThe town library needs more books. If you have old scrolls, %2$s...%3$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.guru_sekolah.2: %1$sThere's a genius in my class. If only the family could afford further schooling.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.guru_sekolah.3: %1$sSpirit root testing next week. The children are nervous; the parents more so.%2$s

kultivator.cakap.kilas.anak_direkrut.0: My child is in your sect now, %1$s. How are they? Eating enough?
kultivator.cakap.kilas.anak_direkrut.0.k: My kid's in your sect. If anyone hurts them, I'll come myself. Remember.
This one's child is now your sect's disciple, %1$s. Guide them firmly and fairly.
My little one's in your sect, right, %1$s? Look after them. They forget their warm coat.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.dicuri.0: My things went missing when you passed by before. I haven't forgotten.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.dicuri.2: Since that day I lock my stall twice.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.rumah_rusak.2: If you must fight again, do it outside the town walls.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_lunas.2: My father always said, judge a person by how they pay debts. You passed.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_mangkir.0: You never paid your old debt. Don't pretend you forgot.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_mangkir.0.k: A debt left alone becomes karma that blossoms, %1$s.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_mangkir.1: I've waited too long. When will you pay?
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_mangkir.1.k: Your debt's still chalked on my kitchen wall, child. Gathering dust.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_mangkir.2: No one in this market will lend to you again. You know why.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.cerita_ortu.0: My mother used to tell me about you, %1$s. Said you were good. Seems she was right.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.cerita_ortu.0.kas: My father said you're trouble. I haven't decided yet.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.cerita_ortu.0.kun: My elders spoke your name in their tales, %1$s. Now I see you myself.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.cerita_ortu.1: My grandfather still tells of the day you came to this town, %1$s. I was small then.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.cerita_ortu.1.kam: Granny often talks of you, %1$s. Says you helped build the bridge.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.cerita_ortu.2: As a child I thought you were a legend, %1$s. Turns out you're real!

kultivator.cakap.kilas.janji_tempo.2: I can't wait for the %1$s. %2$s, right?

kultivator.cakap.kilas.janji_lewat.0.kun: A promise past its time leaves a small wound in the heart, %1$s.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.janji_lewat.1.p: I can't even look my mother-in-law in the eye. That %1$s, %2$s...
kultivator.cakap.kilas.janji_lewat.2: Maybe you were busy, %1$s. Still... I'm disappointed.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang.0: Ahem. About the %1$s you borrowed... it's due %2$s.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang.1: Not to dun you, but that %1$s is my family's food money. %2$s, all right?
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang.1.kampung: That %1$s, child... it's for seed. %2$s works, right?
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang.2: If you can't pay it all, half for now will do.

kultivator.cakap.kilas.lama.0.pelabuhan: Long voyage, mate? Last I saw you was %1$s!
kultivator.cakap.kilas.lama.1: %1$s! It's been so long. Much has changed since %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.lama.1.p: %1$s! Goodness, since %2$s! My child walks now.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.lama.1.oasis: Friend! This spring has missed you since %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.lama.2: I thought you'd forgotten us, %1$s. Not a visit since %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.lama.3: Tell me, where've you been since %1$s? Plenty of adventures, surely.

kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.0.kampung: Oh, %2$s... the harvest failed, the debts pile up. I'm lost.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.1: %1$sMy child won't listen any more, %2$s. Every time I advise, they walk off.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.1.p: %1$sMy husband keeps coming home late, %2$s. Says it's work... who knows.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.1.l: %1$sMy wife's always angry, %2$s. Whatever I do is wrong.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.2: %1$sI miss %2$s, %3$s. Sometimes I still set out two bowls.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.2.kuno: %1$sI still see %2$s's shadow in every corner of the house, %3$s.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.3: %1$sCustomers are few, the stall rent's up. Maybe I should just go back home.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.3.pelabuha: %1$sThe fish stay away, the net's torn, the boat leaks. The sea is angry with me, %3$s.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.keluh.4: %1$sNo one understands me, %2$s. Only you will listen.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.0: There now, don't be sad, %1$s. The sun rises again tomorrow.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.0.kasar: Stop whining. Come drink, you'll forget.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.0.kuno: Every winter ends in spring, %1$s. Be patient.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.0.kampung: There, it's all right, %1$s. We're all here. I'll help.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.1: You're not alone, %1$s. If you need anything, knock on my door.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.1.p: Come, %1$s. Eat at my place tonight. I'll make soup.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.1.pelabuha: The sea gets angry sometimes, %1$s, but always calms again. So will you.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.2: Young ones are like that. We were stubborn too, remember?
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.2.kuno: A young tree must fight the wind before it roots deep, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.3: %1$s surely wouldn't want you crying forever, %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.4: Let's go to the temple. Burn incense, calm the heart. %1$s
kultivator.cakap.curhat.hibur.5: Remember when we were small and lost in the woods? We made it, didn't we. This too shall pass.
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.0: Know why %1$s's cat is fat? It eats my fish every night! Hahaha!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.0.kasar: Know the difference between you and a buffalo? The buffalo works. Hahaha!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.0.kuno: A cultivator meditated a hundred years, then woke and asked: who ate my bun?
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.0.pelabuh: A drunk sailor searched for port all night, mate. Turned out he was on the dock all along!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.1: Yesterday I haggled so hard over a fish the seller offered to walk home with it himself!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.1.kampung: Yesterday the headman's buffalo walked into school, child. Sat at the front. More diligent than my boy!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.1.oasis: My friend's camel can count, friend. Only to two, though. After that it spits.
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.2: Hear that? %1$s's rooster crows at midnight. They say it joined a heretic sect.
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.2.gunung: A young monk fell asleep at prayers. His snore was sweeter than the bell. Amitabha.
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.3: My wife says my cooking tastes like medicine. I said: so it's healthy!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.3.p: My husband says I chatter like a bird. I said: but birds never forget your birthday!
kultivator.cakap.canda.lelucon.4: If I were a cultivator, I'd fly to market. To skip the queue.
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.0: Oh, %1$s, your shirt's inside out! Off to a festival or a funeral?
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.0.kasar: %1$s, your face is crumpled as laundry. Hahaha!
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.0.kuno: %1$s walks today like a crane with a broken wing.
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.0.kampung: %1$s, did you bathe in water or mud this morning? Hehe.
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.1: %1$s, I hear you lost at chess to a seven-year-old?
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.1.pelabuhan: %1$s, I hear you got seasick at the fish pond? Hahaha!
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.2: You, %1$s, laugh like a hen laying an egg.
kultivator.cakap.canda.olok.3: %1$s, your hat's too big. From afar I took you for a walking umbrella.
kultivator.cakap.canda.tawa.0: Hahaha! The things you come up with!
kultivator.cakap.canda.tawa.1: Hahaha! Stop, stop, I can't take it!
kultivator.cakap.canda.tawa.1.pelabuhan: Hahaha! A ship's joke! I'll tell the crew later!
kultivator.cakap.canda.tawa.1.kampung: Hahaha! Enough, enough, my eyes are watering!
kultivator.cakap.canda.tawa.2: Hehe, just you wait, I'll get you back.
kultivator.cakap.canda.tawa.3: Hahaha! Funniest thing I've heard this month!
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.gosip.0.pela: %1$s! Off the boat a moment, I've something to tell.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.gosip.1: Oh, %1$s! What luck. I was just about to look for you.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.gosip.1.p: Oh, %1$s! Bucket full? Sit a moment, I've a story.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.gosip.2: %1$s, have you heard? Oh, not yet. Sit down first.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.merayu.0: O-oh, %1$s. What a coincidence meeting you here.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.merayu.0.kas: %1$s. You... pass this way too, huh.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.merayu.0.air: %1$s... you came to this bridge too...
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.merayu.1: %1$s! You look... different today. Good, I mean.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.merayu.1.kam: %1$s, off to the paddies? Me too. Let's walk together.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.merayu.2: Hi, %1$s. I'm not passing on purpose, honestly.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.dagang.0: Come, %1$s! Look at my goods, just in this morning!
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.dagang.0.pel: %1$s! Fresh cargo, straight off the boat!
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.dagang.1: Ah, %1$s. A loyal regular. I've something good for you.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.dagang.1.kam: %1$s, drop by. The morning greens are still fresh.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.ajar.0.kasar: Another lesson, Master? My legs still ache from yesterday.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.ajar.0.kuno: The disciple pays respects to the Master.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.ajar.0.kampu: Sir! What are we learning today?
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.ajar.1: Master %1$s, I'm here. What do we learn today?
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.ajar.1.gunun: I've swept the yard, Master %1$s. Pray guide me today.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.ajar.2: Master, I practised till night yesterday! Look, my hands are blistered.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.curhat.0: %1$s... do you have time? I need to talk.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.curhat.0.kas: %1$s. Sit. I need someone to talk to.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.curhat.0.kun: %1$s, my friend. This heart is heavy.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.curhat.0.kam: %1$s, come here. Keep me company a while.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.canda.0.kasa: Oi, %1$s! Your ugly mug again! Hahaha!
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.canda.0.kuno: Ho ho, %1$s. Your face is bright; a sign of a funny tale.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.canda.0.kamp: Hey, %1$s! Thinner? Wife on a cooking strike? Hehe.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.canda.1: %1$s! Perfect, I've got a funny one.
kultivator.cakap.sapa.obrol.canda.2: Hey, %1$s! You fell in the gutter yesterday, right? The whole lane saw!
kultivator.cakap.rayu.sepakat.0: Y-yes... I'll come. But don't tell anyone.
kultivator.cakap.rayu.sepakat.0.kuno: If %1$s invites, this one won't refuse.
kultivator.cakap.rayu.sepakat.0.air: Yes... I'll wait at the bridge...
kultivator.cakap.rayu.sepakat.1: Hehe... all right. I'll wear my best clothes.
kultivator.cakap.rayu.sepakat.1.kampung: Yes, yes. But Mother mustn't find out.
kultivator.cakap.rayu.sepakat.2: All right. But you're buying the candied haws.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.sepakat.0: Of course, %1$s. What are friends for if not helping each other?
kultivator.cakap.curhat.sepakat.0.kampun: Yes, %1$s. I'll come to your house tomorrow morning.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.sepakat.1: Don't worry. We'll sort it out together.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.sepakat.1.p: There, there. Tomorrow I'll bring rice and greens.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.sepakat.2: Leave it to me. I know someone who can help.
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.0: %1$s, know what? Yesterday %2$s's hen walked into the teahouse and ordered tea. The owner served it!
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.0.kasar: Listen, %1$s. That drunk slept in the pen again. This time the goat moved out.
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.0.kuno: A funny tale, %1$s: a cultivator meditated on a roof and was taken for laundry.
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.0.pelabuha: %1$s, the green ship's captain got drunk and saluted the mast. The mast didn't answer!
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.1: Yesterday I haggled a fishmonger to tears, %1$s. Then he haggled back till I cried!
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.1.kampung: %1$s, the headman's buffalo walked into school again. The teacher even took its attendance!
kultivator.cakap.canda.cerita.2: Guess, %1$s: what's the difference between a gate guard and a statue? The statue doesn't charge a toll!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.0: So dear! Knock a bit off.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.0.ku: That price is too high for a small purse like mine.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.0.ka: Oh, dear, sir. A bit off, for a regular.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.0.oa: By the spring, that's too dear, friend! Half that!
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.1: Yesterday the next market was cheaper. Match it.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.1.pe: Cheaper at the next dock, mate. Don't take me for a newcomer.
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar.obrol.2: I'll take two if the price drops. How's that?
kultivator.cakap.dagang.tawar_balik.obro: Oh, at that I'd lose! A little more.
No. That's final. Take it or go.
This one takes a profit thin as an onion skin.
You offer that? Funny. The last one who did didn't go home whole.
Fine, let's meet in the middle. But tell no one.
I have three children, %1$s. Have a little pity.
Goods like this cost double in the capital. This is already very cheap.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.0.kasar: Hey. Got a story. Want it or not?
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.0.kuno: A tale is going round, %1$s. Perhaps of interest to a wise ear.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.0.pelabuhan: Come here, mate, closer. News from the docks.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.0.oasis: Sit, friend. The desert wind carries news.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.0.air: Dear... come here a moment... there's something I want to tell...
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.1: You won't believe what I heard %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.1.kampung: Child, know what happened %1$s? The whole village is abuzz!
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.1.iblis: Got news. Free, this once. Don't get used to it.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.2: Come closer. This mustn't be overheard.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.2.p: Come closer, this is women's business... well, everyone's, really.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.3: I have a story, but promise not to say it was me.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.3.kasar: Got a story. Blab and I'll pull your tongue out.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.4: %1$s... ah, but it's a secret. Fine, I'll tell. Only a little.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.4.ibukota: There's a whisper in this district. Unofficial, of course. But everyone knows.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.5: Guess who was the talk of the well this morning?
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.5.gunung: Monks shouldn't gossip. But... Amitabha, this one's different.
kultivator.cakap.umpan.gosip.6: Sit first. It's a long story and a bit mad.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.0: %1$s Truly? First I've heard of it!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.0.kuno: Truly beyond expectation. The mortal world is full of surprises.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.0.oasis: By the spring! You're not joking, friend?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.1.kampung: What, %1$s? Really? They seem so ordinary.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.2: Goodness, goodness... I need to sit down.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.3: No wonder! I felt something was off since yesterday.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.3.iblis: Hm. Figures. In this city a surprise means someone's about to lose something.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kaget.4: Well, well, well. Then the market will be in uproar tomorrow.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.0.kuno: Hearsay without roots, %2$s. I won't swallow it whole.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.0.pelabuhan: Dock news is like yesterday's fish, mate. More smell than meat.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.1: Hmm, I'm not sure. %1$s isn't that sort.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.1.kampung: Would %1$s really do that? I've known them since they were small, child.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.1.ibukota: An accusation like that needs a witness. In the capital, slander is punishable.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.2: Did you see it yourself, or just hear it?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.2.air: Did you see it yourself, dear...? Or hear it from a boatman?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.3: Yesterday the story was different. Tomorrow it may change again.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.ragu.3.iblis: Lies are cheaper than bread here. I'm not buying.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.0: %1$s That's the best news this week!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.0.kuno: Truly a blessing of heaven. My heart opens to hear it.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.0.oasis: Like rain on the desert, friend! Wonderful!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.1: Hahaha! Good, good! I'll drink to that tonight.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.1.p: Hehe, how lovely! I'll bring cakes to celebrate.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.1.kampun: Oh, thank goodness, child! I'll tell the wife; she'll be glad too.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.2: Finally some good news. It's been nothing but bad lately.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.2.pelabu: A fair wind at last, mate! Full sail!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.4: This calls for a celebration! Who's buying?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.gembira.4.kasar: This calls for a celebration. You're paying.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.0.kasar: Damn. Why is it always the good ones.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.0.kuno: The wheel of fate is cruel. May light follow this darkness.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.1: Oh dear... my heart grows heavy hearing it.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.1.air: Oh, dear... now my tears are falling...
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.1.kampung: Oh, child... poor thing. I'll bring rice to their house later.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.2.gunung: All that is born will suffer. Amitabha... still, it's sad to hear.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.3: I don't know what to say.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.3.p: Now I want to cry too...
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.sedih.4: If there's anything I can do, just say. %1$s
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.0.kuno: Insolent! Such a deed stains heaven and earth.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.0.pelabuha: Scoundrel! On my ship I'd have thrown them overboard!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.0.iblis: Hm. That one needs to learn manners. With a knife if need be.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.1: Tch! I suspected it all along. That sort!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.1.kampung: The nerve! If I see them, I'll douse them in gutter water!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.1.p: Ugh! If they pass, I'll sweep their feet!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.2.kasar: My blood's boiling. Where are they?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.3: This can't stand. Someone must tell the guards.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.marah.3.ibukota: This must go to the magistrate. The capital has laws.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.0: Oh, now I'm scared... Are we safe?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.0.kuno: I have a bad feeling about this. We had best be wary.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.0.air: O-oh... dear... I don't dare walk home alone tonight...
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.1: D-don't say that... it might come true.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.1.kampung: Hush! Don't say that, child. It's bad luck.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.2: I have to go home and check on the children.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.2.p: I must go home. My children are alone.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.cemas.4: Do the guards know? Someone has to tell them.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.0: Hmm. Same old. What else is new?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.0.kasar: And? What am I supposed to say?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.0.kuno: News like that comes and goes like clouds.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.1.pelabuhan: Waves rise, waves fall, mate. So does news.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.2: That again? Three people told me today.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.2.p: That again? I've heard it three times at the well.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.jemu.3: Let it be. Not my business.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.0: Amazing! I never would have thought!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.0.kuno: Truly extraordinary. Such ability appears once in a thousand years.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.0.oasis: By the spring, that's astounding, friend!
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.1: Wow! Tell it again, how did it happen?
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.1.kampung: Wow, great! I'll tell the kids, it'll fire them up.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.1.air: Oh, dear... what a lovely story...
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.kagum.3: If I were young, I'd want to be like that too.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.netral.0.kuno: Is that so. I'll remember it.
kultivator.cakap.reaksi.netral.3: Well, the world is like that.

kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.0.kuno: Allow me to set it straight. My own eyes witnessed it.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.0.pelabuh: Not so, mate. I was on the dock then.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.0.kampung: No, not like that, child. I saw it myself.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.1: Wait, wait. %1$s isn't to blame. The truth is different.
