kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.1.air: No, dear... %1$s didn't... I saw from the boat...
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.2: The story's been spiced. The original wasn't half so dramatic.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.2.kasar: It's been spiced. The real thing's dull.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.3: Who told you? That's half true, half invented.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.4: The truth: it happened, but not that badly.
kultivator.cakap.koreksi.saksi.4.p: The truth is this: it happened, but it's all mended. Don't drag it out.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.0: Right, right! I think so too.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.0.kuno: Your view is most apt. I concur.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.1: There it is! At last someone agrees with me.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.1.p: There! That's what I've been telling the women since yesterday.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.2.ibukota: Wholly agreed. The ministers ought to hear this.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.3: Just as my grandfather used to say.
kultivator.cakap.setuju.4: If everyone thought like us, this town would prosper.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.5.air: Dear... come a little closer... there's news...
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.6: Pardon the interruption; there is news worth hearing.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.6.kuno: Permit this one to relay something.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.7: Fortunate we met; there is something I wish to tell you.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.9: The market is buzzing about something.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.9.ibukota: The district hall is buzzing about something.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.13: Amitabha. News has reached this mountain.
kultivator.cakap.awal.kabar.15: Well, there's word from the village hall.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.0: That's the news that reached my ears.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.0.kuno: Such is the news that reached this one.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.1: True or not, I'm only passing it on.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.3: Don't spread it yet, will you.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.3.kasar: Leak it, and you answer to me.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.4: That's what folk say, not me.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.5: The well is already buzzing with it.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.5.pelabuhan: The docks are already buzzing with it.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.8: Who knows, it may serve you.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.9: News like this goes stale fast, so I'm telling you now.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.10: That is all I managed to hear; may it be of use.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.11: Perhaps that is enough to weigh.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.12: Believe it or not, up to you.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.14: Tomorrow there may be other news.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.15: News from the sea reaches land quickly, mate.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.16: News blows with the desert wind, friend.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.17: Amitabha. May this news not cloud the heart.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.18: Information has a price. This piece I give free.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.kabar.20: That's what they say, dear... I only overheard...
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.6: Just today alone is like this.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.7: Forgive me if this sounds like complaining.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.8: May this one grumble a moment?
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.9: Ah, the sorrows of mortal life.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.13: Friend, before the sun sets, hear this.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.16: Don't be shocked. Everyone here grumbles.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.17: Dear... may I grumble a little...
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.18: You know, I nearly gave up.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.20: May I tell you a little something?
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.22: I've been brooding on this all day.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.23: Forgive me, my heart is heavy today.
kultivator.cakap.awal.keluh.24: If it weren't you, I'd keep quiet.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.0: Who knows how long it'll stay like this.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.3: Sorry for turning this into a vent.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.6: Tomorrow may be better. May be.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.7: At least there's still warm tea.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.7.pelabuhan: At least there's still wine at the tavern, mate.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.11: This one can only be patient.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.13: Even sand eventually stops moving, friend.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.16: Doesn't mean I give up. Just tired.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.17: Sorry, dear... I've made myself sad...
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.20: But well, that's how we are.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.21: It feels a relief to have told it.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.23: May the next season be kinder.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.keluh.24: If you see a way out, tell me.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.1: Drop by if you have time.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.7: Keep walking, don't block the way.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.9.kuno: This one prays for your safety.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.12: May a spring always be near, friend.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.14: Careful now, the path is slippery.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.15: Be careful. Here the walls have ears.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.sapa.17: May your business in this city go well.
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.5: If I may make small talk.
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.6: Permit this one to chat a moment.
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.7: Sit a while; it's nice to chat.
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.10: Mate, while we wait for wind.
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.11: Friend, while we wait for shade.
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.14: Dear... while waiting for the boat...
kultivator.cakap.awal.basa.17: It's been a while since we chatted like this.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.2: That's all that's in my head.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.3: Sometimes it's little things like this that make a place home.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.5: Tell me some time about where you're from.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.7: Such is this one's idle chatter.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.8: Dockside talk is just like this, mate.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.9: Talk by the spring never runs out, friend.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.10: Amitabha. Even silence is a conversation.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.11: Well, that's village folk for you.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.12: Sorry, dear... I talk too much...
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.13: Even small talk has a price here.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.14: Small talk like this is refreshing.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.15: May today be good to you.
kultivator.cakap.ekor.basa.19: Thank you for keeping me company in talk.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.0: %1$sYesterday %2$s, today %2$s. My leaky roof has given up.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.0.kasa: %2$s yet again. Heaven is testing people's patience on purpose.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.0.kuno: This one is weary of the endless %2$s; this one cannot refuse heaven's will.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.1: %1$sMy bones creak whenever the weather turns. No physician is as precise.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.1.kamp: %1$sMy back aches each time the weather turns, child. It's an omen, they say.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.2: %1$sBecause of the weather no customers came. I waited alone all day.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.2.pela: %1$sWeather like this, no ships sail, the tavern's empty, mate.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.3: %1$sThe children are shut in by the weather. My house is like a fish market.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.4: %1$sI've hung the washing out three times and taken it in three times. Three times for nothing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.cuaca.4.p: %1$sMy washing never dries properly. My husband's clothes all smell musty.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.0: %1$sWork piles up and nobody helps. One pair of hands for three jobs.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.0.kasa: %1$sEveryone's lazy and I do the work. Usual.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.1: %1$sThe foreman scolded me for someone else's mistake. I kept quiet. What use is defending myself?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.1.kuno: %1$sThis one bears another's fault and chooses silence.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.2: %1$sFor two days I've had no time for lunch. My stomach has stopped protesting.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.2.p: %1$sMy feet are swollen from standing all day. The master doesn't want to know.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.3: %1$sThat new hand is paid more than me, though I've been here ten years.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.3.kamp: %1$sA newcomer gets more pay than me, child. What a world.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.4: %1$sIf only I had a spirit root, I wouldn't have to shoulder sacks like this.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kerja.4.ibli: %1$sIn this city muscle is sold cheap and folly sold dear. I sell muscle.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.0: %1$sMy kitchen permit has been held three months. The clerk says his desk is full.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.0.ib: %1$sMy permit papers wander from desk to desk. Every desk wants its own envelope.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.1: %1$sThe tax man comes with a ledger I can't read and numbers I can't dispute.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.1.ka: %1$sThat tax man is a robber with a seal.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.2: %1$sThe new official talks sweet as honey. But the honey only goes into his own pocket.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.3: %1$sWe asked for the well to be mended. Answer: wait for the budget year. Which year, who knows.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.3.ka: %1$sAsked for a bridge, promised an opening ceremony. Still no bridge.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.4: %1$sThe small folk queue from dawn, the official arrives near noon. When does justice wake?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.pejabat.4.ku: %1$sThe people wait at the gate from dawn; the masters arrive with the sun high.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.0: %1$sI've counted three times and it's still short. The money won't grow.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.0.kasar: %1$sPocket's got a hole. Money in, money gone.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.1: %1$sMy mother's medicine costs more than a month's pay. I eat once a day.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.1.p: %1$sThe housekeeping is cut again. I must conjure dinner out of two coins.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.2: %1$sA copper once bought a plate of buns. Now it buys only the smell.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.2.kampu: %1$sA hen was ten coins; now thirty. Who can manage that, child?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.3: %1$sI saved for years for a new roof. One illness and the savings were gone in a night.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.4: %1$sMy friends have all done well, and I'm still counting small change. Sometimes I'm ashamed to greet them.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.uang.4.iblis: %1$sIn this city having no money means having no friends. I've learned that.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.0: %1$sYesterday %2$s was still within reach. Today the trader eyes me like a thief.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.0.kasa: Folk sell %2$s like gold when it tastes like dirt.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.1: %1$sThe only cheap thing left is %2$s. We eat it every day.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.1.kamp: %1$sOnly %2$s is still cheap, child. Day after day it's just %2$s.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.2: %1$sThe trader says prices rose because the roads are bad. The cart driver says because traders are greedy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.3: %1$sI compared prices at three stalls. All three agreed to throttle equally.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.3.ibuk: %1$sThree shops on Market Street, the exact same price. That's no coincidence.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.4: %1$sMy child cried for sweets. All I could do was point at the moon.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.harga.4.p: %1$sMy child asked why we don't buy sweets any more. Hard to answer.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kejahatan.0: %1$sMy purse vanished in the middle of the crowd. Nobody saw. Always the same.%2$s
%1$sThe market pickpockets work tidier than the guards.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kejahatan.1: %1$sThe neighbour's door was jimmied last night. Now I leave the lamp lit till morning.%2$s
%1$sThieves run rampant. This one no longer dares sleep deeply.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kejahatan.2: %1$sYoung toughs go in gangs now, threatening small traders, asking protection money. The guards pretend not to know.%2$s
%1$sProtection money. Here we call it air rent. Dear too.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kejahatan.3: %1$sYesterday I heard a scream in the alley. I shut my door. I'm ashamed, but I was afraid.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.kejahatan.4: %1$sA neighbouring trader was cheated by a stranger with false scales. He lost a month's takings.%2$s
%1$sA foreign crew cheated the fish trader with a crooked balance. Big loss, mate.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.0: %1$sThe trader who went %2$s last week hasn't come back. His wife waits at the gate each evening.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.0.kuno: %1$sThose who took the %2$s road did not return. This one can't face the wives.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.1: %1$sCaravan guards' wages doubled because of the bandits. So goods got dear too.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.2: %1$sThe %2$s road used to be the main one. Now people detour three days to be safe.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.2.oasi: %1$sThe %2$s route was once the golden route. Now the sand swallows reckless caravans, friend.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.3: %1$sI had an uncle taken by bandits. Since then nobody dares speak of that road.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.4: %1$sThe guards say they'll send a troop. They've said so two seasons now.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.begal.4.pela: %1$sThe sea patrol promised to crush the pirates. Two seasons promising and ships still vanish.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.0: %1$sPests gnawed half my field. I put up straw, charms and prayers. All for nothing.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.0.kamp: %1$sHoppers ate half the rice, child. Prayers, charms, scarecrows, I've tried them all.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.1: %1$sThis year's harvest only covers the tax. For ourselves, who knows.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.2: %1$sThe middlemen come to bargain low while the grain's still wet. They know we have no choice.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.3: %1$sRain came late, heat came too soon. The crops are as confused as we are.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.3.kuno: %1$sRain and heat out of season. Even the soil has lost its way.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.panen.4: %1$sMy child won't carry on the field. Says they want to be a sect disciple. Who is this field for?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.0: %1$sI envy %2$s. Their life looks light. Maybe it's only me hoarding burdens too tight.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.1: %1$sAt night I lie awake thinking of old age. Who will look after me?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.1.kun: %1$sThis one thinks of the twilight years drawing near. No one will keep me company.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.2: %1$sI've tried to be a good person, %2$s. Why do I only ever get pebbles?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.2.kas: %1$sBeing good in this town only makes you a target, %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.3: %1$sThey say I'm too quiet. They don't know how noisy my head is.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.3.p: %1$sMy husband never asks whether I'm sad. I can't be bothered explaining.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.curhat.4: %1$sMy house is quiet since the children left. Sometimes I still cook supper for four.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.0: %1$sMy regular customer moved to the next stall. Says the prices are friendlier. I lose twice over.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.0.kas: %1$sBuyers come only to haggle, then leave. A fine hobby.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.1: %1$sStocks of %2$s pile up in the warehouse and nobody buys. My capital is locked in there.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.2: %1$sThe stall rent is up again. I feel I trade for the landlord, not for myself.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.2.ibu: %1$sStall rent in the east market is up again. The owner is kin to a district official, of course.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.3: %1$sThe caravan was three days late. Half my ordered goods have spoiled. Who pays the damages?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.3.oas: %1$sThe caravan was held by a sandstorm, friend. My ordered dates dried into stones.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.lagi.dagang.4: %1$sThe market warden checked my scales again. Fifth time this month. I suspect someone's jealous.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.0: I was wrong, %1$s. I should have thought before speaking.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.0.kasar: Fine, my fault. Don't keep going on about it.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.0.kuno: This one was presumptuous, %1$s. Pray be magnanimous.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.0.gunung: Amitabha. My words just now were muddy, %1$s. Forgive me.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.1: I was rude earlier. If you like, I'll treat you to tea in apology.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.1.pelabuhan: I was rough earlier, mate. I'll stand you a drink at the tavern to make up for it.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.1.p: I was impolite earlier, wasn't I. Sorry. Shall I bake you a cake?
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.2: Truly, I regret it. Please give me a chance to make amends.
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.2.air: I regret it, dear... truly... give me one more chance...
kultivator.cakap.maaf.lagi.2.oasis: I regret it, friend. Let the spring witness my vow.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.0: It's not stinginess, %1$s. My own purse is thin enough.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.0.kasar: Find someone else. I'm no almshouse.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.0.kuno: This one is powerless, %1$s. Pray seek another hand.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.1: If I agree, I'm the one who gets scolded, %1$s. Sorry.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.1.ibukota: District rules forbid it. Please don't press, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.1.iblis: Not free, not today, not for you. Take your pick of reasons.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.2: I'd like to, truly. But there's no time. Another day, maybe.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.2.kampung: I'd like to, child, but my field's waiting. Another time.
kultivator.cakap.tolak.lagi.2.p: Oh, sorry... the children are waiting at home. Another time.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.0: Enough! One more word and I call the guards.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.0.kasar: One more word and I break your jaw.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.0.pelabuhan: One more word and you're bathing off the dock, mate!
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.1: I've been patient. My patience has limits, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.1.kuno: This one's patience is no bottomless well, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.1.iblis: Know what happens to those who test my patience? No, because no one lives to tell it.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.2: Mind your mouth! Not everyone here is as kind as you think.
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.2.p: How rude! Go before I call my husband!
kultivator.cakap.marah.lagi.2.kampung: What rudeness! Go, before I throw hot water!
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.0: D-don't come closer... please... I have nothing...
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.0.kasar: B-back! I can shout! I mean it!
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.1: My legs won't move... Please, I'm not resisting...
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.1.p: Please... I only want to go home to my children...
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.1.pelabuhan: Mercy, mate... I'm only a porter...
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.2: Yes, yes, take it! Just don't hurt me!
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.2.iblis: Take it. Take everything. I still want to see the sunrise.
kultivator.cakap.takut.lagi.2.air: T-take it, dear... I'm so scared...
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.0: And I'd told everyone you'd surely come, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.0.kasar: Fine. Next time I won't believe you.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.0.kuno: This one placed hope, %1$s. Seems I placed it wrongly.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.1: It's all right. I'm used to being let down. It still hurts.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.1.p: It's all right... truly... I just need to sit a moment.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.1.kampung: Well, child, never mind. This old heart's used to disappointment.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.2: I thought it meant something to you. Turns out only to me.
kultivator.cakap.kecewa.lagi.2.air: I thought it mattered to you, dear... it didn't, did it...
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.0: Hmph. Your realm is high, but your mouth is a gutter.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.0.kuno: Your cultivation impresses; your manners do the opposite.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.0.pelabuhan: Dashing looks, empty head. Like a ship without a rudder, mate.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.1: Go. Don't dirty the lane I just swept.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.1.kampung: Off with you, child. Don't dirty the yard I just swept.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.2: You think everyone fears you? We only know when to keep quiet.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.2.iblis: Fear? We're only waiting for someone bigger to knock you down.
kultivator.cakap.hina.lagi.2.oasis: Even a camel knows when its master is wrong, friend. You don't.
kultivator.cakap.selamat.lagi.0: Oh, great news! I'll treat you to sweets tonight, %1$s!
kultivator.cakap.selamat.lagi.0.kasar: Hm. Good. Don't forget who knew you before you rose.

kultivator.cakap.curhat.minta_tolong.0: %1$s... could you help me? I don't know who else to ask.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.minta_tolong.0.k: My friend %1$s, this one begs your help.
%1$s, lend me a sack of rice. I'll repay at harvest.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.minta_tolong.1: If you know a physician, %1$s, let me know. My child hasn't recovered.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.minta_tolong.1.p: Please mind my children tomorrow, %1$s. I have to go to the next town.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.minta_tolong.2: Lend me a little money, %1$s. I'll repay at month's end. I swear.
kultivator.cakap.curhat.minta_tolong.3: Come with me to speak to the headman, %1$s. I'm afraid to go alone.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.0: Shh... about %1$s. %2$s there's a tale few people know yet.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.0.kasar: Shh. %1$s. You know how it is. Don't say I told you.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.0.kuno: There's a whisper about %1$s, %3$s. Only for trustworthy ears.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.0.pelabuha: Come here, mate. About %1$s... the dock has known since %4$s.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.1: Not so loud. %1$s, you see... ah, you'll hear soon enough.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.1.kampung: Shh, child. That %1$s... the village has whispered since %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pemain.2: I'm saying nothing, mind. But watch %1$s when they pass.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.0: Shh... %1$s and %2$s. Something's going on between them. Believe me.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.0.kasar: %1$s and %2$s. Rotten. That's all I'll say.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.0.kuno: There's a tangled knot between %1$s and %2$s. This one dares say no more.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.0.kampun: That %1$s and %2$s, child... shh, I'll tell you at the well.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.1: Know why %1$s never passes %2$s's house any more?
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.1.p: The women at the well say %2$s and %1$s had a terrible row. Shh.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.tetangga.2: I heard it through the wall. The walls here are very thin. %1$s
kultivator.cakap.bisik.asmara.0: Hehe, shh... %1$s and %2$s! I saw them on the bridge yesterday, just the two.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.asmara.0.kuno: The red thread seems to join %1$s and %2$s. Shh, not yet official.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.asmara.0.air: Dear... %1$s sent a lantern to %2$s... on the canal... so romantic...
kultivator.cakap.bisik.asmara.1: Don't tell anyone. %1$s wrote %2$s a letter. Three pages!
kultivator.cakap.bisik.asmara.1.kampung: Shh, child. %1$s keeps bringing guavas to %2$s's house. Hehe.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.asmara.2: The matchmaker has sniffed it out. Once she sniffs, it's just a matter of the date.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pejabat.0: Shh... the official at %1$s. They say %2$s has business that isn't clean.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pejabat.0.kuno: There are rumours of %2$s at %1$s. Best be careful saying it.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pejabat.0.ibukota: In the capital, walls have ears. But... %2$s, at %1$s... you understand.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pejabat.1: If you want quick business at %1$s, find %2$s. Bring an envelope. Shh.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pejabat.2: I'm saying nothing. But where did %1$s's new house money come from?
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pasar_hantu.0: Shh... %1$s. Midnight. No red lanterns, only white.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pasar_hantu.0.kas: %1$s. Night. If you die, not my fault.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pasar_hantu.0.kun: The gate of the spirit market opens at %1$s. Bring a calm heart.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pasar_hantu.0.ibl: %1$s. I know you'll go. Buy me something. Don't ask what.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pasar_hantu.1: If you go to %1$s tonight, don't answer if someone calls your name from behind.
kultivator.cakap.bisik.pasar_hantu.2: I hear someone sells long-life pills there. The price... memories. Shh.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.0: Oh, the famous %1$s. Must be nice being the talk of the town.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.0.kasar: Hah, %1$s. Hero of the market. How marvellous.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.0.kuno: %1$s's name soars high. May it not fall too hard.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.0.iblis: %1$s. Fame is dangerous, you know. Easier to find.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.1: Well, well, the great cultivator arrives. Please don't break anything today.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.1.kampung: Well, well, a great one visits our little village. What did I dream last night?
kultivator.cakap.sindir.pemain.2: Very impressive. So much that small folk needn't do anything any more.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.tetangga.0: %1$s is the most honest person in this lane. According to %1$s, anyway.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.tetangga.0.kasar: %1$s? Hah. A saint. In the dark.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.tetangga.0.kuno: How virtuous %1$s is. The virtue only shows when someone's watching.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.tetangga.1: Oh, %1$s helped someone? Someone must have been watching.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.tetangga.1.p: Oh, %1$s's cooking is good? Sure, if you like charcoal. Hehe.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.tetangga.2: %1$s says they never gossip. Then they tell you about everyone.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.opini.0: Yes, yes, %1$s always knows everything. Shame they're not a minister.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.opini.0.kasar: %1$s talks a lot. Where's the work?
kultivator.cakap.sindir.opini.0.kuno: %1$s's opinions are always loud. Like an empty barrel, as the saying goes.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.opini.1: If %1$s's talk could be sold, they'd be the richest in town.
kultivator.cakap.sindir.opini.2: Of course %1$s is right. Always right. Just ask them.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.0: %1$s's cough is getting worse. I fear it's no ordinary cough.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.0.ka: The physician here is useless. I'm worried.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.0.ku: %1$s's Qi weakens day by day. This one is restless every night.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.0.ka: Oh, child, %1$s hasn't risen from the mat since %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.1: The physician's medicine is gone, but the fever won't drop. What do I do?
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.1.p: My child hasn't eaten since yesterday. My heart can't rest.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.kesehatan.2: If only there were a healing pill... but it costs the earth.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.0: %1$s hasn't come home since midday. Usually home before the lanterns are lit.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.0.kasar: %1$s is roaming again. When they get back, I'll box their ears.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.0.kuno: This one's heart is uneasy. %1$s hasn't returned, and the woods beyond the wall are unkind.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.0.kampung: %1$s went to the stream at midday, child. Not back yet. I'm scared.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.1: %1$s wants to join a sect. I fear they'll be hurt there. But if I forbid it, they'll hate me.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.1.p: %1$s wants to be a warrior. What mother wouldn't be afraid?
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.anak.2: %1$s's friends are all rascals. I worry they'll lead them astray.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.cita.0: I want to open my own shop, but if it fails, what will my family eat?
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.cita.0.kasar: Dreams? Dreams are expensive. I can't afford them.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.cita.0.kuno: The road I wish to walk is thorny. This one doubts these legs are strong enough.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.cita.1: The spirit root test is next year. If I have no roots, what's left for me?
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.cita.1.kampung: I want to try my luck in the city, child. But who'll look after Mother?
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.cita.2: Everyone says my dream is too high. Maybe they're right.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.sekte.0: If the sects go to war again, our town will be dragged in. I'm afraid.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.sekte.0.kasar: Sects fight, we die. Always the way.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.sekte.0.kuno: The sects' strife is like two elephants clashing; it's the grass that gets trampled.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.sekte.1: Foreign sect disciples pass more often lately. What's really going on?
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.sekte.1.pelabu: Foreign sect ships dock without trading, mate. Strange. I don't like it.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.sekte.2: The protector sect's tribute is up again. I fear we won't have enough this year.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.keluarga.0: %1$s works too hard. I'm afraid they'll fall ill.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.keluarga.0.kun: This one fears for %1$s's health. The human body has limits.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.keluarga.1: My mother is old. Every morning I fear she won't wake.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.keluarga.1.kam: Mother's very old, child. Every morning I check she's breathing first.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.keluarga.2: School fees, rent, medicine... sometimes I can't sleep for thinking of it.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.0: Last night strange sounds came from the woods. Like roaring. I couldn't sleep.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.0.kasar: Something's wrong beyond the wall. Lock your door.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.0.kuno: This one senses an unpleasant aura from the %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.0.air: The water's changed colour, dear... dead fish floating... I'm scared...
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.1: The guards patrol more often. If the guards are worried, we should be more so.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.1.pelab: The gulls have been silent since yesterday, mate. Not a good sign.
kultivator.cakap.khawatir.bahaya.2: Two of my animals vanished this week. No human tracks.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.cuaca.0.kuno: %3$sHeaven is sullen. This one can only be patient.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.cuaca.0.kampung: %3$sThe weather's all over the place, child. The rice could rot like this.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.cuaca.1: %1$sIf the weather stays like this, the harvest could fail. Then what?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.cuaca.1.pelabuhan: %1$sWeather like this, mate, no boats go out. No wages come in.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.cuaca.2: %1$sMy knees ache whenever the weather turns. More accurate than the almanac.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.0: %1$sThe foreman added hours, but the pay's the same. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.0.kasar: %1$sWork like a buffalo, paid like a chicken.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.0.kuno: %1$sThis one's toil isn't matched by the pay. But what can be done.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.0.kampung: %1$sWorking dawn to dusk, the pay barely covers rice.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.1: %1$sMy back isn't straight any more. Next year, who knows if I'll still manage.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.1.p: %1$sMy hands are cracked from the master's washing water. But who cares?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kerja.2: %1$sThat new foreman is so harsh. One slip, docked pay.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.pejabat.0: %1$sTaxes up again. Officials grow fatter, we grow thinner.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.pejabat.0.kuno: %1$sThe officials forget their chairs rest on the people's backs.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.pejabat.0.ibukota: %1$sGetting a paper at the district office takes three months. Without an envelope.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.pejabat.1: %1$sThe road outside my house has been broken two years. Reported three times.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.pejabat.1.kampung: %1$sThe headman promised a bridge. Promises, promises; where's the bridge?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.pejabat.2: %1$sWant justice, bring money. No money, bring patience.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.uang.0: %1$sOnly a few coins left in my purse. Month's end is far off. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.uang.0.kuno: %1$sThis one's purse is dry as a well in drought.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.uang.0.kampung: %1$sMoney's gone, child. My tab at the stall is as long as my arm.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.uang.1: %1$sThe lender came again yesterday. The interest alone is bigger than the debt.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.uang.1.iblis: %1$sDebts in this city are paid in coin or fingers. I still have ten fingers. For now.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.uang.2: %1$sPrices up, wages flat. How are small folk to save?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.harga.0: %1$s costs like gold now. Once a coin bought a sackful. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.harga.0.kuno: %3$sThe price of %1$s soars, and the small folk bear it.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.harga.0.oasis: %1$s costs more and more, friend. Even caravans can't afford it.
kultivator.cakap.keluh.harga.1: %1$sI haggled half an hour for just a little %2$s.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.harga.1.p: %1$sMarket shopping now is like war. Come home with an empty purse and basket.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.harga.2: %1$sIf this goes on, what will we eat this winter?
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kejahatan.0: %1$sThe pickpockets grow bolder. They strike in broad daylight.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kejahatan.0.kuno: %1$sCrime grows like weeds when the watch is lax.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kejahatan.0.kampu: %1$sChickens keep vanishing in the village, child. The thief's still not caught.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kejahatan.1: %1$sThe shop next door was broken into last night. I lock my door three times now.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kejahatan.1.iblis: %1$sCrime? Here it's called trading. Problem is when I'm the one robbed.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluh.kejahatan.2: %1$sThe guards arrive after the thief has gone. Always.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.0: Don't take the %1$s road alone. Bandits have roamed there since last season.
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.0.kasar: The %1$s road? If you want robbing, go ahead.
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.0.kuno: The road %1$s is held by a bandit gang. Pray be wary, %2$s.
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.0.oasis: Desert bandits wait behind the dunes to the %1$s, friend. They strike at the height of noon.
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.1: The last caravan was robbed in the %1$s woods. Two guards were hurt.
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.1.pelabu: Not bandits, mate, pirates! In the %1$s waters. Don't sail alone.
kultivator.cakap.begal.peringat.2: If you must go, join a group. Bandits won't attack a big party.
kultivator.cakap.begal.keluh.0: %1$sBecause of the bandits on the %2$s road, our carts must detour two days. %3$s
kultivator.cakap.begal.keluh.0.kuno: %1$sThe bandits rob the people's toil. Heaven will surely repay them.
kultivator.cakap.begal.keluh.1: %1$sBandits took my goods last month. I still haven't recovered.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.begal.keluh.1.kampung: %1$sBandits made off with old Darmo's buffalo, child. The whole village is furious.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.begal.keluh.2: %1$sIf any cultivator would clear that road, the whole town would be grateful.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.0: %1$sEaten yet? The buns down the road just came out of the steamer.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.0.kasar: %1$sHungry? Go buy. Don't eye my food.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.0.kuno: %1$sA full belly calms the mind, %3$s. Have you dined?
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.0.kampung: %1$sEaten, child? Don't be shy, there's plenty of rice in the kitchen.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.0.pelabuha: %1$sGrilled fish just off the fire, mate! You can smell it from the ships!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.0.oasis: %1$sDates and flatbread, friend. Simple desert food, but filling.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.1: %1$sThe pulled noodles next door are wonderful. The broth simmers all night.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.1.air: %1$sThe fish congee on the morning boat, dear... the best on the canal...%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.basa.2: %1$s like this is perfect for ginger soup.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.makanan.tawar.0: Want to try my cake? Fresh out. Free, for you, %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.tawar.0.kampung: Here, child, boiled cassava. Still warm. Take some, take some.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.tawar.1: I cooked too much. Take some home, will you?
kultivator.cakap.makanan.tawar.1.p: I made dumplings this morning. Take a packet for the road.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.tawar.2: Tea's just brewed. Sit down, have a cup.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.cerita.0: This bun recipe's from my grandmother. The secret is a splash of wine in the dough. Tell no one.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.cerita.0.kuno: Long ago, they say, an emperor got lost and ate a commoner's porridge. Since then it's been called palace porridge.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.cerita.1: Ever had capital roast duck? The skin crackles like glass.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.cerita.1.pelabu: In the southern sea, mate, there's a fish with meat sweet as honey. I ate it once.
kultivator.cakap.makanan.cerita.2: As kids we ate rice with salt. Look now, meat every week.
kultivator.cakap.panen.kabar.0: %1$sThe harvest is good this year! Plump grain, the granary nearly full. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.panen.kabar.0.kuno: %1$sThe earth is generous this year. Full granaries, peaceful hearts.
kultivator.cakap.panen.kabar.0.kampung: %1$sBumper harvest, child! The headman's paddies needed twenty hands.
kultivator.cakap.panen.kabar.1: %1$sThe peach orchard on the hill is heavy with fruit. Peach prices will surely fall.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.panen.kabar.1.gunung: %1$sThis season's tea leaves are the most fragrant in ten years. The monks give thanks.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.panen.kabar.2: %1$sEveryone's busy in the paddies. The market's quiet, but hearts are glad.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.panen.keluh.0: %1$sPlanthoppers struck the east paddies. Half the rice is gone. %2$s
kultivator.cakap.panen.keluh.0.kuno: %1$sHeaven withholds its mercy this year. The granaries are half empty.
kultivator.cakap.panen.keluh.0.kampung: %1$sThe grain's hollow, child. The rain came a month late.
kultivator.cakap.panen.keluh.1: %1$sWild boar got into the field last night. My corn is trampled flat.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.panen.keluh.2: %1$sIf the harvest fails again, I'll have to sell the buffalo.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.0: Back when I was little, that river was crystal clear. We swam till our lips turned blue.
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.0.kasar: The past. No use remembering. But yes... it was better.
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.0.kuno: Memories of youth are like flowers pressed in a book; still fragrant though fragile.
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.0.kampu: Once, child, this village was ten houses. At night we heard tigers roar.
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.0.pelab: When I was young, mate, I sailed to the smoking isles. A mountain coughed fire!
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.1: My father used to take me to the lantern festival. I still remember the fish lantern he bought me.
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.1.p: My mother used to comb my hair every morning, singing. I still know the song.
kultivator.cakap.kenangan.cerita.2: I once saw a cultivator fly over town. White robes billowing like clouds. I've never forgotten.
kultivator.cakap.kabar.umum.0: %1$s there's news about %2$s since %3$s. Everyone's talking about it.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.umum.0.kasar: %5$sThere's news about %2$s. I don't care, but you might.%4$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.umum.1: Heard about %1$s? I only found out this morning.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.umum.1.kampung: Heard yet, child? About %1$s. The whole village is in uproar.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kabar.umum.2: %1$sAbout %2$s... you'll hear it from others. More complete. %3$s
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.0: %1$s... I haven't forgotten my debt to you, %2$s. Give me until %3$s, please.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.0.kas: My debt to you. %2$s. I'll pay. Don't dun me in public.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.0.kun: This one's debt of %2$s to you, %1$s, will be settled before %3$s.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.0.kam: My debt of %2$s, child... I'll pay after harvest. I swear.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.1: Sorry, %1$s, the money isn't together yet. But I'm not running, truly.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.1.p: Sorry, %1$s... I sold my earrings, but it's still a little short.
kultivator.cakap.kilas.utang_warga.2: Here, half for now. The rest %1$s. Thank you for being patient.
kultivator.cakap.tutup.sabar_habis.0.kun: Pray excuse me, %1$s. Worldly matters call this humble one.
kultivator.cakap.tutup.sabar_habis.0.pel: That's it for now, mate. The tide won't wait.
kultivator.cakap.tutup.sabar_habis.0.air: Sorry, dear... %2$s... we'll chat again later...
kultivator.cakap.tutup.malam.0: It's night, %1$s. Don't wander too late; plenty of bandits.

kultivator.cakap.tutup.malam.1.air: The canal lanterns are lit, dear... good night...
kultivator.cakap.tutup.malam.2: The moon is high. I'm off home.

kultivator.cakap.tutup.dingin.1: Hmph. Don't stand in front of my stall again.

kultivator.cakap.tutup.dingin.2: I've nothing more to do with you.
kultivator.cakap.tutup.dingin.3: May our roads not cross again.

kultivator.cakap.tutup.pamit_balas.0.ibl: Hm. Still alive next time, hopefully.
kultivator.cakap.tutup.pamit_balas.0.ibu: Farewell, %1$s. May your business in the capital go smoothly.
kultivator.cakap.tutup.pamit_balas.2: Yes, yes. Drop by when you pass.

kultivator.cakap.potong.bahaya.0: Good heavens, what's that?! Run, %1$s, run!

kultivator.cakap.potong.bahaya.2: Hear that? The alarm gong! I have to go!

kultivator.cakap.potong.pelanggan.2: Oh, the queue's long. Wait a moment.

kultivator.cakap.potong.gong.1.pelabuhan: The lighthouse bell, mate. A ship's coming in.
kultivator.cakap.potong.gong.2: Ah, the gong. I nearly lost track of time.

kultivator.cakap.potong.dipanggil.1: Oh, my master's waving. I must go.

kultivator.cakap.potong.dipanggil.2: Someone's calling my name. One moment.
kultivator.cakap.potong.anak.0: Oh, that's my child crying! One moment!
kultivator.cakap.potong.anak.0.kuno: That small cry calls me. Pardon me a moment.
kultivator.cakap.potong.anak.0.kampung: Hey, %1$s! Don't climb that tree! ...Sorry, child, my little one's naughty.
kultivator.cakap.potong.anak.1: %1$s! Don't play near the well! ...Sorry, children these days.
kultivator.cakap.potong.anak.1.p: %1$s! I told you not to bother the hens! ...Oh, sorry.
kultivator.cakap.potong.anak.2: My grandchild fell. Wait, let me look.

kultivator.cakap.potong.sibuk.2: The foreman's looking this way. I'd better look busy. Hehe.
kultivator.cakap.kembali.0: Now, where were we? Oh yes, what we were saying.

kultivator.cakap.kembali.0.pelabuhan: Right, mate, back to the story.
kultivator.cakap.kembali.0.air: Sorry, dear... what were we saying...? Oh, yes...
kultivator.cakap.kembali.1.ibukota: My apologies for the pause, %1$s. Let us go on.
kultivator.cakap.kembali.2: Oh, I nearly forgot. Ah, yes, yes.

kultivator.cakap.kembali.3: Hah, calm again at last. Let's go on.
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.0: %1$sThe sky is so strange today. My mother has burned three incense sticks.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.0.kun: %1$sHeaven shows an omen. The sect elders must be counting the stars.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.0.kam: %1$sA sky like that, child, granny says, means a new king is born.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.0.pel: %1$sA sky like this, mate, the captains won't sail. Afraid the sea god's angry.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.1: Did you see the falling stars last night? I made three wishes!%1$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.1.p: Falling stars last night! I wished for a good match for my child.%1$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.2: %1$sThe children were terrified when the sun vanished. So was I, honestly.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.basa.cuaca.langit.2.gun: %1$sThe monks rang the bell nonstop while the sun was covered. Amitabha.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.0: %1$sMy work finished early today. So rare, I mean to enjoy it.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.0.kuno: %1$sToday's labour is complete, %3$s. This one is grateful.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.0.kampung: %1$sWork's done, child. This afternoon I can lounge on the porch.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.1: %1$sMy master raised my pay a little. Very little, but still a raise!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.1.pelabuhan: %1$sThe captain says I can take the helm next week, mate!%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.1.p: %1$sMy sewing orders are growing. I hope my eyes hold out.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.2: %1$sWe got a big order from a caravan. Busy month ahead for sure.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.kabar.3: %1$sThere's a new hand where I work. Still clumsy, but hardworking.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.0: See this? I made it. Nothing neater in all %1$s.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.0.kasar: I'm the best here. Ask anyone.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.0.kuno: Without meaning to boast, this one's work is recognised as far as the next town.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.0.pelabuhan: My knots never slip, mate, not even in the worst storm!
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.0.kampung: My paddy's the greenest in the village, child. See for yourself.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.1: My master says without me the place would've shut long ago. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.1.p: My cakes are ordered all the way to the officials' houses, you know.
kultivator.cakap.kerja.pamer.2: Ten years working, never once late. Not once!
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.0: %1$s came early this year. Just look at the trees.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.0.kuno: %1$s has arrived; heaven and earth change their face.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.0.kampung: %1$s, child. Time to change what's in the garden.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.1: %1$sThe almanac says this %2$s will be long. Lay in supplies.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.1.pelabuhan: %2$s, mate. The wind changes direction, and so do the fish.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.1.oasis: %1$sIn the desert %2$s only means slightly different heat, friend.%3$s
kultivator.cakap.musim.kabar.2: %1$sEvery %2$s I make candied fruit. Want to try some later?
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.0: %1$sMy parents are still well back home. Every season I send money.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.0.kuno: %1$sMy family's forebears came from the %3$s. Their ashes are still there.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.0.kampung: %1$sMy little sister wed last month, child. Now only I'm left. Heh.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.1: %1$sMy elder brother went to the capital. His letters come every full moon.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.1.pelabuh: %1$sMy father was a fisher, my grandfather too. Me? A fisher, of course, mate.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.2: %1$sOur house is small but always lively. Seven under one roof.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.keluarga.umum.3: %1$sMy mother still cooks for everyone though she's old. Can't stop her.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.tetangga.umum.0: %1$sMy next-door neighbour just hung a new lantern. Red, big, very bright.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.tetangga.umum.0.kuno: %1$sA good neighbour is worth more than distant kin, say the ancestors.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.tetangga.umum.0.kampung: %1$sThe neighbour bought a goat, child. Now I wake every morning to bleating.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.tetangga.umum.1: %1$sA new family moved to the end of the lane. Three kids, all noisy.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.tetangga.umum.1.p: %1$sThe lady next door handed out layer cake yesterday. So kind.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.tetangga.umum.2: %1$sThe neighbour's cat sleeps on my roof every afternoon. I count it as mine now.%2$s
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.0: When I'm free, I like sitting by the river watching boats pass. That's all, but it's lovely.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.0.kasar: Free time? I sleep. That's my hobby.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.0.kuno: In idle hours, this one copies old poems. It calms the mind.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.0.kampun: Evenings I like chatting at the watch post, child. The men tell all sorts.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.1: I'm learning the flute. The neighbours say it sounds like a trapped cat. Heh.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.1.p: I love planting flowers in pots. Twenty pots on my windowsill now.
kultivator.cakap.kebiasaan.umum.2: Every market day I browse the caravans' odd goods, even if I don't buy.
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.0: %1$s can count to a hundred! Only five years old!
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.0.kasar: %1$s is the strongest of the lane's kids. Takes after me.
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.0.kuno: My child %1$s knows three chapters of the classics by heart. Even the teacher is amazed.
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.0.kampung: %1$s rides the buffalo alone now, child! Such a brave one.
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.1: The teacher says %1$s is the brightest in class. I'm not surprised, of course.
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.1.p: %1$s made me a bamboo hairpin. Look, lovely, isn't it?
kultivator.cakap.anak.pamer.2: If %1$s's spirit roots were tested, they'd be good. I'm sure of it.
kultivator.cakap.ranah.tanya.0: What realm are you at now, %1$s? I can't sense Qi, so I'm only guessing.
kultivator.cakap.ranah.tanya.0.kasar: Are you strong yet? Or just for show?

kultivator.cakap.ranah.tanya.0.kampung: Mister, can cultivators live a thousand years once they're high enough?

kultivator.cakap.ranah.tanya.1.pelabuhan: Can cultivators command the waves, mate? Truly?
kultivator.cakap.ranah.tanya.2: How long do you meditate each day, %1$s? I can't sit still five minutes.
kultivator.cakap.sekte.tanya.0: Where's your sect, %1$s? Does it take disciples from little towns like this?

kultivator.cakap.sekte.tanya.0.kuno: What path does your sect walk, %1$s? Sword, alchemy or formations?

kultivator.cakap.sekte.tanya.1: Is it true your sect's disciples can come home every new year?
kultivator.cakap.sekte.tanya.1.p: In your sect, the disciples get enough to eat, right? I worry for the children there.
kultivator.cakap.sekte.tanya.2: If your sect needs workers, I'm good at cooking and fixing roofs.
